Stakeholder engagement in business activities is conducted in various ways to ensure aspirations and inputs can be effectively and efficiently captured. Our engagement methods include regular meetings, site visits, satisfaction surveys, and other activities. We always ensure that the Company's business activities, especially those that impact many stakeholders, can provide the best contribution. Therefore, we strive to accept and adopt aspirations, hopes and input from stakeholders.

In addition to proactively engaging stakeholders, we also provide accessible channels for stakeholders to submit complaints and grievances. These reporting channels are outlined in Regulation of the Board of Directors No. PD-014/SMI/1123, dated November 9, 2023, concerning 1st Revision of Grievance Mechanism Procedure for Affected Communities and Observers.

dengan dukungan dari seluruh pihak, termasuk para pemangku kepentingan. Program peningkatan kapasitas para pemangku kepentingan dilakukan melalui empat kelompok besar kegiatan, yakni:

2. Coaching clinic terkait mitigasi dampak lingkungan dan sosial, peningkatan kapasitas internal Perseroan mengenai mitigasi risiko sosial dan lingkungan. Coaching clinic dilaksanakan sesuai kebutuhan, umumnya dilakukan saat Perseroan memberikan jasa layanan pembiayaan sarana publik yang dilaksanakan Pemerintah Daerah. Materi coaching clinic umumnya mengenai bagaimana menyiapkan suatu proyek pembangunan infrastruktur publik dengan baik dan telah memasukkan parameter mitigasi sosial lingkungan yang akan dilaksanakan, sehingga realisasi pembangunan proyek dapat berjalan dengan lancar tanpa gangguan risiko sosial, dan tanpa menimbulkan dampak negatif terhadap lingkungan sekitarnya.
3. Menanamkan nilai pembangunan infrastruktur berkelanjutan. Kegiatan ini dilaksanakan dalam bentuk program pelatihan dengan subjek dan tujuan spesifik, yakni meningkatkan kompetensi jajaran karyawan dalam menerapkan kebijakan mitigasi dampak sosial dan lingkungan dari pelaksanaan pembangunan proyek infrastruktur yang dibiayai PT SMI.
4. Knowledge management perkembangan infrastruktur di Indonesia melalui Infralib. Infralib adalah platform berbasis website dan aplikasi mobile yang dapat menyimpan data dan dimanfaatkan untuk berbagi pengalaman dan pengetahuan mengenai infrastruktur di Indonesia.

Sebagai bagian integral dari Divisi Riset Ekonomi PT SMI, SMI Institute berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi dalam menciptakan pembangunan yang inklusif dan berkelanjutan di daerah berbagai kegiatan riset dan capacity building.

Dalam bidang riset, SMI Institute melaksanakan serangkaian kegiatan strategis untuk mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi yang inklusif dan berkelanjutan di daerah. Beberapa kegiatan strategis tersebut antara lain:

Goals (SDGs). These goals can be realized with the support of all stakeholders. Therefore, we continuously enhance stakeholder capacity on a regular basis to align understanding and improve knowledge regarding the significant role of infrastructure in national development, establish a shared perspective on the importance of social and environmental risk mitigation, and provide insights into the relationship between infrastructure and SDG achievement.

The stakeholder capacity-building program is carried out through four main activities:

1. Engagement with clients, investors, and partners regarding opportunities for social and environmental risk mitigation in infrastructure projects. In this activity, PT SMI conducts outreach through videos that explain the principles of environmental and social management as part of the implementation of sustainable finance principles.
2. Coaching clinics on environmental and social impact mitigation, as well as internal capacity building for the company in managing social and environmental risks. These coaching clinics are conducted as needed, typically when the company provides financing services for public infrastructure projects undertaken by local governments. The sessions generally cover how to properly prepare a public infrastructure development project, incorporating social and environmental mitigation parameters to ensure the project's smooth execution without social risk disruptions or negative environmental impacts.
3. Instilling the values of sustainable infrastructure development. This activity is conducted through training programs with specific subjects and objectives, aimed at enhancing employee competencies in implementing policies for mitigating social and environmental impacts in infrastructure projects financed by PT SMI.
4. Knowledge management on infrastructure development in Indonesia through Infralib. Infralib is a web-based and mobile application platform designed to store data and facilitate knowledge-sharing on infrastructure development in Indonesia.

## 1. Kajian Regional Diagnostic

Bekerjasama dengan Lembaga Penyelidikan Ekonomi dan Masyarakat FEB UI, SMI Institute melakukan kajian regional diagnostic untuk membantu pemerintah daerah melakukan perencanaan strategis berbasis data di bidang infrastruktur. Kajian ini mengidentifikasi infrastruktur prioritas yang mampu memberikan dampak maksimal terhadap perekonomian lokal, peningkatan Pendapatan Asli Daerah (PAD), serta peningkatan kualitas layanan publik dengan memahami kondisi sosial, ekonomi, dan politik daerah. Kajian ini dilakukan dengan melibatkan berbagai pemangku kepentingan seperti pemerintah daerah, DPRD, akademisi, Regional Chief Economist Kementerian Keuangan (Kemenkeu), asosiasi pengusaha, dan organisasi kemasyarakatan. Hingga tahun 2024, SMI Institute telah melaksanakan kajian regional diagnostic di 10 daerah di Indonesia (Provinsi Kepulauan Riau, Provinsi Kalimantan Selatan, Provinsi Jawa Barat, Kota Banjarbaru, Kota Bitung, Kota Gianyar, Kota Palangkaraya, Kota Solok, Kota Bogor, dan Kabupaten Morowali Utara). Kajian ini menemukan bahwa setiap wilayah membutuhkan prioritas infrastruktur yang berbeda, mencerminkan tantangan dan potensi ekonomi yang unik dari tiap daerah. Namun, sektor air bersih, persampahan, dan perumahan masih menjadi tantangan umum yang memerlukan percepatan pembangunan infrastruktur di daerah.

## 2. Kajian Clustering Daerah

Mengingat keberagaman kondisi daerah di Indonesia, sangat sulit mencari kebijakan 'one size fits all' yang efektif bagi seluruh daerah. Kajian clustering daerah dilakukan untuk membantu Pemerintah dan PT SMI dalam merancang kebijakan dan strategi pembiayaan yang lebih tepat sasaran sesuai karakteristik sosial-ekonomi dan kapasitas fiskal daerah. ## 1. Regional Diagnostic Study

In collaboration with the Institute for Economic and Social Research (LPEM) at the Faculty of Economics and Business, University of Indonesia (FEB UI), SMI Institute conducts Regional Diagnostic Studies to assist local governments in developing data-driven strategic infrastructure planning. This study identifies priority infrastructure projects that can generate the greatest economic impact, increase local revenue (PAD), and improve public service quality by analyzing the region's social, economic, and political conditions. The study is conducted with the involvement of various stakeholders, including local governments, regional legislative councils (DPRD), academics, Regional Chief Economists from the Ministry of Finance, business associations, and civil society organizations. As of 2024, SMI Institute has conducted Regional Diagnostic Studies in 10 regions across Indonesia, (Riau Islands Province, South Kalimantan Province, West Java Province, Banjarbaru City, Bitung City, Gianyar City, Palangkaraya City, Solok City, Bogor City and, North Morowali Regency). The study findings indicate that each region has different infrastructure priorities based on its unique economic challenges and potential. However, the clean water, waste management, and housing sectors remain common challenges that require accelerated infrastructure development at the regional level.

## 2. Regional Clustering Study

Given the diverse conditions across Indonesia, it is challenging to implement a "one size fits all" policy that effectively addresses the needs of all regions. The Regional Clustering Study is conducted to assist both the Government and PT SMI in designing more targeted policies and financing strategies that align with the socio-economic characteristics and fiscal capacity of each region. Some regions have low fiscal capacity and lower levels of welfare, requiring greater financial support, while other regions are more financially independent and ready to adopt more innovative financing instruments. Through this clustering approach, PT SMI can diversify its financing products to better suit the specific needs of each region. The regional clustering process is conducted at both the provincial and municipal (city/regency) levels to ensure a more precise policy and financing approach.

This study aims to strengthen the understanding of the challenges and solutions in green financing in Indonesia, while also serving as a successful model for Green Financing across the ASEAN region.

## 4. Waste Management Sector Study

In collaboration with InterCAFE IPB, we conducted an in-depth study on the conditions, challenges, and alternative solutions in Indonesia's waste management sector. The study highlights the need for a holistic waste management approach from upstream to downstream, rather than solely focusing on waste processing at final disposal sites. It emphasizes the importance of behavioral change among communities and the active involvement of local stakeholders at the upstream level. Collaboration among all stakeholders, both at the central and regional levels, is essential in addressing waste management issues across various regions in Indonesia.

Hasil kajian ini juga dapat digunakan sebagai dasar kegiatan peningkatan kapasitas pemerintah daerah dalam pengelolaan isu-isu kesehatan dan sosial secara lebih efektif, berkelanjutan, dan terintegrasi.

Based on the 2022 Indonesia Nutritional Status Study (SSGI), TTS Regency recorded the highest stunting rate in Indonesia. This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the root causes, as well as the social and economic impacts of stunting.

Ini the study, we actively collaborate with stakeholders at the sub-district, regency, and provincial levels to identify key challenges and formulate effective solutions. The study has resulted in policy recommendations and strategic programs, including priority infrastructure development that can be immediately implemented by local governments. Additionally, the study serves as a foundation for capacity-building initiatives to help local governments manage health and social issues more effectively, sustainably, and in an integrated manner.

# 1. Executive Course for Local Government Financial Managers

PT SMI, in collaboration with the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Home Affairs, provides support for enhancing the capacity of financial management personnel within local governments through an Executive Course. This specialized and continuous program is designed for senior management officials responsible for financial management in regional governments. The course aims to address the challenges of fiscal decentralization, including:

a. Risks of regional economic slowdown, which require optimization of local government spending.
b. Harmonization of national and regional fiscal policies to achieve national and regional development targets.
c. Formulation of more efficient, outcome-based fiscal policies at the regional level.

The program also includes Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, which serve as an inspiration for enhancing credibility, accountability, and efficiency in government spending, while contributing to sustainable development.

## 2. Creditworthiness Academy

Creditworthiness Academy (CWA) adalah program kolaborasi PT SMI, the World Bank, dan BPPK Kemenkeu yang dirancang secara komprehensif, praktis, dan berkelanjutan untuk membantu pemerintah daerah dalam meningkatkan kinerja pengelolaan keuangan publik dan peringkat kredit. Program ini bertujuan untuk memperkuat sisi "demand" pembiayaan dengan merencanakan proyek yang berkualitas, serta meningkatkan sisi "supply" pembiayaan dengan melibatkan investor yang potensial serta identifikasi pembiayaan kreatif. Berbagai kegiatan peningkatan kapasitas yang dilakukan mencakup pelatihan penggunaan alat penilaian mandiri, penyusunan rencana aksi yang disesuaikan dengan tantangan dan kebutuhan daerah, serta tindakan strategis lainnya untuk meningkatkan kelayakan kredit dan memastikan tersedianya layanan infrastruktur daerah yang berkualitas.

Dalam kegiatan ini, juga disampaikan materi mengenai Climate Finance yang bertujuan membantu pemerintah daerah memahami cara mengakses dan memanfaatkan pembiayaan iklim guna mendukung pembangunan yang berkelanjutan. Materi yang disampaikan meliputi sumber utama pembiayaan iklim serta cara dan best practices mengintegrasikan pendanaan tersebut dalam strategi keuangan daerah. Saat ini sedang dirancang program credit worthiness untuk tahun 2025 yang merupakan kolaborasi antara PT SMI, the World Bank, dan BPPK Kemenkeu.

## 2. Creditworthiness Academy

The Creditworthiness Academy (CWA) is a collaborative program between PT SMI, the World Bank, and BPPK (Ministry of Finance). It is designed to be comprehensive, practical, and sustainable, helping local/regional governments improve public financial management performance and credit ratings. This program aims to strengthen both the "demand" and "supply" sides of financing. On the demand side, by assisting local governments in planning high-quality projects. On the supply side, by engaging potential investors and identifying innovative financing mechanisms. Various capacity-building activities include training on the use of self-assessment tools, the development of action plans tailored to regional challenges and needs, and other strategic measures to enhance creditworthiness and ensure the availability of high-quality regional infrastructure services.

During this event, a session on Climate Finance was also presented, aimed at helping local governments understand how to access and utilize climate financing to support sustainable development. The session covered key sources of climate financing, as well as methods and best practices for integrating such funding into regional financial strategies. Currently, a credit worthiness program is being designed for 2025 as a collaboration between PT SMI, the World Bank, and BPPK (Financial Training and Education Agency) of the Ministry of Finance.

PT SMI konsisten menerapkan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik atau Good Corporate Governance (GCG) untuk memastikan usaha yang dijalankan terus tumbuh dan berkembang. Penerapan GCG sekaligus merupakan sarana untuk menjaga kepercayaan masyarakat dan pemangku kepentingan yang lain bahwa Perseroan mengoperasikan bisnis secara transparan, akuntabel dan beretika. Tata kelola yang baik juga memungkinkan Perseroan menjalankan operasi yang selaras dengan harapan publik, menciptakan citra positif, dan membangun reputasi yang kokoh.

Lebih dari itu, implementasi tata kelola perusahaan yang baik juga berkontribusi terhadap efisiensi operasional dan peningkatan kinerja keuangan PT SMI. Dalam hal ini, penerapan GCG mendorong terlaksananya sistem pengawasan internal yang lebih ketat sehingga alokasi dan penggunaan berbagai sumber daya yang dimiliki Perseroan menjadi lebih efektif. Lebih lanjut, dengan adanya proses pengambilan keputusan yang transparan dan terstruktur, maka Perseroan dapat memastikan bahwa semua keputusan didasarkan pada analisis yang matang untuk meningkatkan profitabilitas perusahaan.

Hal yang tak kalah penting, penerapan GCG juga memungkinkan PT SMI memenuhi tanggung jawab sosial dan lingkungan secara berkelanjutan. Sulit dimungkiri, selain mengejar keuntungan sebagaimana entitas bisnis, Perseroan juga dituntut kontribusinya dalam mendukung kesejahteraan masyarakat serta menjaga kelestarian lingkungan. Melalui tata kelola perusahaan yang baik, Perseroan memastikan bahwa semua aktivitas dan kebijakan perusahaan mempertimbangkan dampak sosial dan lingkungan, serta mendukung terwujudnya pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Untuk mendapatkan hasil terbaik dalam penerapan GCG, prinsip-prinsip GCG yang dikembangkan dan diterapkan PT SMI sebagai Special Mission Vehicle (SMV) dari Kementerian Keuangan mengacu pada Undang-Undang tentang Perseroan Terbatas dan peraturan dan ketentuan lain yang berlaku seperti Peraturan Menteri Keuangan (PMK) No. 88/PMK.06/2015 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik pada Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) di bawah Pembinaan dan Pengawasan Menteri Keuangan serta Keputusan Menteri Keuangan No. 505/KMK.06/2020 tentang Pedoman Penilaian dan Evaluasi atas Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik pada Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) di bawah Pembinaan dan Pengawasan Menteri Keuangan.

PT SMI remains steadfast in implementing Good Corporate Governance (GCG) to ensure continuous business growth and development. The implementation of GCG serves as a crucial mechanism to maintain public and stakeholder trust, reinforcing that the Company operates transparently, accountably, and ethically. Strong governance also enables the Company to align its operations with public expectations, foster a positive corporate image, and build a solid reputation.

Beyond regulatory compliance, effective corporate governance contributes to PT SMI's operational efficiency and financial performance. By adopting GCG principles, the Company ensures a more rigorous internal control system, allowing for optimal resource allocation and utilization. Additionally, a transparent and structured decision-making process enables PT SMI to base all strategic choices on comprehensive analysis, ultimately enhancing profitability.

Equally important, the implementation of GCG allows PT SMI to fulfill its social and environmental responsibilities sustainably. As a business entity, the Company not only pursues financial gains but is also committed to contributing to societal welfare as well as environmental preservation. Through good corporate governance, the Company ensures that all activities and policies take into account social and environmental impacts, while also supporting the realization of sustainable development.

# Struktur dan Mekanisme
Tata Kelola [GRI 2-9]
Governance Structure and Mechanism [GRI 2-9]

Struktur tata kelola PT SMI terdiri dari Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS), Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, sebagaimana diatur dalam Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perusahaan Terbatas. Sesuai regulasi yang sama, sistem kepengurusan Perseroan menganut sistem dua organ (two tier system), yaitu Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang memiliki tugas, wewenang dan tanggung jawab yang jelas sesuai fungsinya masing-masing.

## Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS)

Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) adalah organ Perseroan yang memegang kekuasaan tertinggi dan wadah bagi para Pemegang Saham untuk dapat berperan serta dalam proses pengambilan keputusan penting dengan memperhatikan kepentingan Perseroan dalam jangka panjang. RUPS juga digunakan pemegang saham untuk menentukan arah pengembangan dan mengevaluasi kinerja pengurus Perseroan yakni Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.

Secara umum, Perseroan memiliki 2 (dua) jenis RUPS, yakni RUPS Tahunan ("RUPST") dan RUPS lainnya atau RUPS Luar Biasa. Pembahasan dan jenis RUPS di lingkungan Perseroan adalah sebagai berikut:

1. RUPS Pengesahan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perusahaan ("RKAP") selambat-lambatnya 30 (tiga puluh) hari setelah tahun anggaran berjalan;
2. RUPS Pengesahan Laporan Tahunan tahun buku yang bersangkutan diadakan dalam jangka waktu paling lambat 6 (enam) bulan setelah tahun buku berakhir;
3. RUPS Pengesahan Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan, yang dilakukan setiap 5 (lima) tahun sekali, selambat-lambatnya 30 (tiga puluh) hari setelah periode berjalan; dan
4. RUPS lainnya atau RUPS Luar Biasa yang dapat diadakan setiap waktu berdasarkan kebutuhan untuk kepentingan perusahaan.

Perseroan mengukur kinerja pengurus berdasarkan capaian kualitatif dan kuantitatif melalui RUPS yang mencakup aspek pengelolaan organisasi, Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM), pengembangan usaha, kinerja ekonomi, sosial maupun lingkungan. Berdasarkan Peraturan Menteri Keuangan No. 88/PMK.06/2015 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik pada Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) di bawah Pembinaan dan Pengawasan Menteri Keuangan, RUPS

The Company's governance structure consists of the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS), the Board of Commissioners, and the Board of Directors, as stipulated in Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies. In accordance with the same regulation, the Company adopts a two-tier governance system, in which the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors have distinct duties, authorities, and responsibilities based on their respective functions.

## General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS)

The General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) is the principal organ within the governance structure, holding the highest authority in the Company and providing a forum for Shareholders to participate in the decision-making process while considering the Company's long-term interests. The GMS also allows shareholders to determine the development direction and evaluate the performance of the Company's administrators, namely the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors.

In general, the Company has two (2) types of General Meetings of Shareholders (GMS), namely the Annual GMS ("AGMS") and other GMS or Extraordinary GMS. The discussions and types of GMS within the Company are as follows:

1. GMS for the Ratification of the Company's Work Plan and Budget ("RKAP") no later than 30 (thirty) days after the current fiscal year;
2. GMS for Ratification of the Annual Report for the relevant fiscal year is held no later than 6 (six) months after the fiscal year ends;
3. GMS for the Ratification of the Company's Long Term Plan, which is held every 5 (five) years, no later than 30 (thirty) days after the current period; and
4. Other GMS can be held at any time based on the need for the Company's interests.

The Company evaluates the performance of its management through the GMS based on qualitative and quantitative achievements, covering aspects such as organizational management, Human Capital (HC), business development, economic performance, as well as social and environmental impact. # Dewan Komisaris [GRI 2-9, 2-11, 2-12]

Dewan Komisaris adalah Organ Perseroan yang bertugas dan bertanggung jawab secara kolektif untuk melakukan pengawasan dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi serta memastikan bahwa Perseroan telah menerapkan prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Kedudukan masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris termasuk Komisaris Utama adalah setara satu sama lain. Tugas Komisaris Utama sebagai primus inter pares adalah mengkoordinasikan kegiatan Dewan Komisaris.

Dewan Komisaris memiliki peran penting dalam melakukan pengawasan atas kinerja operasional Perseroan, termasuk implementasi di aspek-aspek keberlanjutan. Dewan Komisaris secara aktif melakukan pemantauan dan memberikan saran terhadap pelaksanaan berbagai program Perseroan terkait tanggung jawab sosial dan lingkungan perusahaan.

# Board of Commissioners [GRI 2-9, 2-11, 2-12]

The Board of Commissioners is a principal organ collectively responsible for supervising and advising the Board of Directors on the Company's management and ensuring that the principles of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) are comprehensively applied. Each member of the Board of Commissioners, including the President Commissioner, holds an equal position with one another. The President Commissioner's role is primus inter pares, coordinating the activities of the Board of Commissioners.

The Board of Commissioners plays a crucial role in overseeing the Company's operational performance, including sustainability aspects. It actively monitors and provides recommendations on the execution of the Company's programs related to corporate social and environmental responsibility.

Untuk mengoptimalkan tugas pengawasan, Dewan Komisaris dibantu oleh organ pendukung berupa Komite Audit, Komite Pemantau Risiko dan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi. Selain itu, Dewan Komisaris juga memiliki organ pendukung lain yaitu Sekretariat Dewan Komisaris. Komite Dewan Komisaris bertugas memberikan rekomendasi maupun pertimbangan atas berbagai isu strategis ataupun kebijakan operasional sesuai keahlian di bidangnya kepada Dewan Komisaris. Rekomendasi komite Dewan Komisaris di antaranya berkaitan dengan penetapan strategi di bidang ekonomi, sosial dan lingkungan yang nantinya menjadi KPI Perseroan, rekomendasi langkah koreksi sebagai bentuk pengawasan jalannya kegiatan operasional, penilaian kinerja bidang-bidang spesifik, menyusun rekomendasi besaran paket remunerasi bagi Dewan Komisaris, Dewan Pengawas Syariah maupun Direksi.

Berkaitan dengan rangkap jabatan, PT SMI memiliki kebijakan bahwa anggota Dewan Komisaris diperkenankan memiliki rangkap jabatan sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan di luar jabatan sebagai pengurus partai politik dan/atau calon anggota legislatif dan/atau calon Kepala Daerah/Wakil Kepala Daerah. Sepanjang tahun 2024, tidak terdapat anggota Dewan Komisaris yang memiliki rangkap jabatan tingkat eksekutif di Perseroan.

## Direksi [GRI 2-9, 2-11, 2-12, 2-14]

Direksi merupakan Organ Perseroan yang bertugas dan bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola Perseroan berdasarkan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Masing-masing anggota Direksi dapat melaksanakan tugas dan mengambil keputusan sesuai dengan pembagian tugas dan wewenangnya.

Secara umum, tugas utama Direksi berkaitan dengan kepengurusan, pengelolaan risiko, pengendalian internal, komunikasi, dan tanggung jawab sosial. Di samping itu, Direksi bertanggung jawab dalam menyusun strategi pengembangan usaha, rencana kerja termasuk menetapkan kebijakan, target, dan sasaran kinerja yang berkaitan dengan aspek-aspek keberlanjutan, pengelolaan risiko, menjalankan kegiatan operasional dan melakukan evaluasi kinerja.

Untuk memaksimalkan pengelolaan Perseroan, Direksi dibantu oleh organ pendukung berupa Komite Direksi, Kepala Divisi, dan Sekretaris Perusahaan. Selain itu, Direksi juga membentuk Satuan Pengendalian Internal untuk memastikan kelancaran komunikasi internal (antar bagian) dan eksternal (dengan pemangku kepentingan) serta menyusun dan melaksanakan kegiatan tanggung jawab sosial Perseroan.

Secara spesifik, terkait aspek-aspek keberlanjutan, Direksi bertanggung jawab dalam menetapkan dan menjalankan program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) dan secara berkala dilaporkan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Pemegang Saham. Direksi juga memastikan pelaksanaan tanggung jawab sosial sesuai dengan ketentuan dan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

To optimize its supervisory duties, the Board of Commissioners is assisted by supporting organs, namely the Audit Committee, the Risk Monitoring Committee, and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Additionally, the Board of Commissioners is supported by the Secretariat of the Board of Commissioners. The Committees of the Board of Commissioners are tasked with providing recommendations or considerations on various strategic issues or operational policies according to their expertise to assist the Board of Commissioners in its supervisory function. Recommendations from the Committees may relate to setting the strategy in economic, social, and environmental fields, which then become the Company's KPIs, suggesting corrective actions as a form of operational oversight, evaluating performance in specific areas, and preparing remuneration packages for the Board of Commissioners, Sharia Supervisory Board, and the Board of Directors.

In terms of concurrent positions, PT SMI has a policy allowing members of the Board of Commissioners to hold concurrent positions as permitted by the Company's Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations, except for positions as political party officials and/or legislative candidates and/or candidates for Regional Head/Deputy Regional Head. Throughout 2024, no member of the Board of Commissioners held executive-level concurrent positions within the Company.

## Board of Directors [GRI 2-9, 2-11, 2-12, 2-14]

The Board of Directors is the Company's organ responsible for managing the Company in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations. Each member of the Board of Directors carries out their duties and makes decisions within their respective areas of responsibility and authority.

In general, the Board of Directors' key responsibilities include corporate management, risk management, internal control, communication, and social responsibility. Additionally, the Board is tasked with developing business strategies, preparing work plans, setting policies, targets, and performance goals, particularly those related to sustainability, risk management, operational execution, and performance evaluation.

To optimize the Company's management, the Board of Directors is supported by Board Committees, Heads of Division, and the Corporate Secretary. Furthermore, the Board has established an Internal Control Unit to ensure smooth internal communication (between departments) and external communication (with stakeholders) while also overseeing the formulation and implementation of corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

Specifically, regarding sustainability aspects, the Board of Directors is responsible for establishing and implementing Social and Environmental Responsibility (CSR) programs, which are periodically reported to the Board of Commissioners and Shareholders. The Board also ensures that corporate social responsibility activities comply with prevailing laws and regulations.

# Pendelegasian Wewenang [GRI 2-13]
## Delegation of Authority [GRI 2-13]

Direksi dapat mendelegasikan sebagian wewenang pengelolaan Perseroan kepada jajaran di bawahnya sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku dengan pertimbangan untuk menunjang kelancaran tugas dan meningkatkan efisiensi dan efektivitas. Wewenang yang bisa didelegasikan antara lain berkaitan dengan pengelolaan aspek-aspek keberlanjutan yaitu menciptakan keselarasan antara aspek ekonomi, sosial dan lingkungan. Pendelegasian wewenang tersebut tidak melepaskan tanggung jawab Direksi.

Lebih lanjut, Kepala Divisi sebagai penerima pendelegasian wewenang harus melaksanakan dengan penuh tanggung jawab, dan memberikan laporan pelaksanaannya secara berkala kepada Direksi. Dalam implementasinya, pendelegasian wewenang dikaji secara periodik untuk disesuaikan dengan tuntutan perkembangan Perseroan.

The Board of Directors may delegate part of its authority in managing the Company to its subordinate levels in accordance with applicable regulations. This delegation is intended to facilitate the smooth execution of duties while enhancing efficiency and effectiveness. The delegated authority may include aspects related to sustainability management, ensuring alignment between economic, social, and environmental aspects. However, such delegation does not absolve the Board of its overall responsibility.

Furthermore, Heads of Division, as recipients of delegated authority, must carry out their responsibilities with full accountability and submit regular reports to the Board of Directors regarding the implementation of their duties. In practice, the delegation of authority is periodically reviewed to ensure alignment with the Company's evolving needs and strategic direction.

# Prosedur Perlindungan Lingkungan dan Sosial sebagai Wujud Komitmen Pengelolaan Operasional yang Ramah Lingkungan [GRI 2-23, 2-24]

Procedure for Environmental and Social Safeguards as a Commitment to Environmentally-Friendly Operational Management [GRI 2-23, 2-24]

PT SMI berkomitmen untuk mengelola kegiatan bisnis dengan meminimalkan dampak negatif serta meningkatkan manfaat positif bagi para pemangku kepentingan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Komitmen ini diwujudkan dengan menyusun dan menerapkan kebijakan atau pedoman terkait keuangan berkelanjutan. Perseroan juga memiliki berbagai pedoman terkait keuangan berkelanjutan, khususnya pedoman yang mengatur pendekatan pengelolaan risiko lingkungan dan sosial dari kegiatan usaha Perseroan. Pedoman tersebut di antaranya Pedoman Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS) Perseroan, Pedoman ESMS Proyek, dan Pedoman Environmental and Social Safeguards (ESS) Proyek Multilateral.

Pada tahun 2020, Perseroan melakukan pembaruan kebijakan terkait pengelolaan risiko lingkungan dan sosial pada kegiatan usahanya dengan merilis Pedoman Perlindungan Lingkungan dan Sosial menggantikan Pedoman ESMS dan Pedoman ESS Proyek Multilateral. Selanjutnya, pada tahun 2022, pedoman ini diubah menjadi prosedur tanpa mengubah isi dari prosedur tersebut sebagai bagian dari perubahan arsitektur kebijakan Perseroan. Prosedur ini mengatur mengenai bagaimana Perseroan melakukan kajian dan mitigasi risiko terkait lingkungan dan sosial dari kegiatan bisnis Perseroan yang mencakup risiko dan/atau dampak pada biodiversitas, masyarakat terkena dampak, pekerja, masyarakat adat, hak asasi manusia dan sebagainya. Melalui pedoman ini, Perseroan mensyaratkan agar para debitur dapat menjalankan mitigasi yang diperlukan sesuai dengan hasil kajian yang dilakukan.

Selanjutnya, pada tahun 2023, Perseroan menerbitkan Prosedur Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan, Kesehatan Kerja, dan Lingkungan yang menggantikan Pedoman Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS) Perseroan. Dalam hal ini, DELST dan divisi terkait lainnya, termasuk Divisi Bisnis, menjalankan prosedur tersebut. DELST juga memberikan dukungan kepada para debitur dalam menjalankan upaya mitigasi risiko lingkungan dan sosial termasuk lewat penyampaian materi sosialisasi, pelatihan dan sebagainya.

PT SMI is committed to managing its business activities while continuously minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive benefits for stakeholders in social and environmental aspects. This commitment is realized by developing and implementing policies or guidelines related to sustainable finance. The Company has various guidelines related to sustainable finance, particularly those that regulate the approach to managing environmental and social risks from the Company's business activities. Among these are the Company's Guidelines for Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS), Guidelines for ESMS Project, and Guidelines for Environmental and Social Safeguards (ESS) of Multilateral Projects.

In 2020, the Company updated its policy related to the management of environmental and social risks in its business activities through the issuance of the Guidelines for Environmental and Social Safeguard, which replaced the Guidelines for ESMS and Guidelines for ESS of Multilateral Projects. In 2022, these guidelines were changed to procedures without altering the content of these procedures as part of the change in the Company's policy architecture. These procedures regulate how the Company conducts studies and mitigates risks related to the environment and social aspects of the Company's business activities, which include risks and/or impacts on biodiversity, affected communities, workers, indigenous peoples, human rights, etc. Through these guidelines, the Company requires debtors to carry out the necessary mitigation according to the results of the studies conducted.

In 2023, the Company introduced Procedure for the Occupational Health, Safety, and Environmental Management System, replacing the previous Guidelines for Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS). Under this new framework, DELST, along with other relevant divisions, including the Business Division, is responsible for implementing the procedure. Additionally, DELST supports debtors in mitigating environmental and social risks by providing awareness materials, training sessions, and other initiatives.

# Manajemen Risiko
Risk Management

PT SMI menyadari adanya berbagai risiko yang dihadapi dalam menjalankan operasional usaha yang berpotensi menghambat pencapaian kinerja dan target-target yang telah ditetapkan. Untuk meminimalkan risiko dan dampaknya, Perseroan melakukan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, pengendalian dan penanganan risiko termasuk mitigasi risiko atas penerapan keuangan berkelanjutan dengan menerapkan Manajemen Risiko. Selaras dengan itu, Perseroan juga telah menerapkan fungsi manajemen risiko yang sejalan dengan kerangka kerja manajemen risiko sebagai langkah untuk memastikan kegiatan usaha yang dilakukan tidak menimbulkan kerugian yang dapat mengganggu kelangsungan usaha Perseroan. Konsistensi dalam menerapkan manajemen risiko merupakan tanggung jawab PT SMI atas mandat yang diberikan oleh Pemerintah yakni sebagai katalis percepatan pembangunan infrastruktur nasional.

## Kerangka Manajemen Risiko

Kerangka kerja manajemen risiko PT SMI disusun dengan menggunakan pendekatan Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). ERM merupakan kerangka kerja yang komprehensif dan integratif untuk mengelola Risiko Kredit, Risiko Penyertaan Modal, Risiko Operasional, Risiko Pasar, Risiko Likuiditas, Risiko Hukum, Risiko Strategis, Risiko Kepatuhan, dan Risiko Reputasi dalam upaya menyeimbangkan antara risiko (risk) dan imbal hasil (return) Perseroan

Sejalan dengan itu, untuk mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis secara berkelanjutan (sustainable growth), Perseroan mengimplementasikan Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) sebagai panduan untuk menjaga keseimbangan antara peran katalis dan keberlangsungan bisnis dalam rangka menjalankan mandat yang diberikan kepada Perseroan. PT SMI senantiasa melakukan pemutakhiran seluruh RAS dengan berpatokan pada kondisi bisnis Perseroan yang semakin dinamis dan kompetitif. Penetapan RAS dilakukan oleh Direksi secara berkala paling lambat setiap dua tahun atau lebih cepat.

Kerangka penerapan manajemen risiko PT SMI selengkapnya adalah sebagai berikut:

PT SMI acknowledges the various risks associated with its business operations, which may hinder the achievement of performance targets and strategic objectives. To minimize risks and their potential impacts, the Company conducts a comprehensive risk management process, including identification, measurement, monitoring, control, and mitigation strategies. This also includes risk mitigation for the implementation of sustainable finance, ensuring that financial sustainability initiatives align with risk management principles. In line with this, PT SMI has established a risk management function that adheres to a structured risk management framework, ensuring that all business activities do not result in losses that could disrupt the Company's sustainability. Maintaining consistent risk management practices is part of PT SMI's responsibility as mandated by the Government, serving as a catalyst for accelerating national infrastructure development.

## Risk Management Framework

PT SMI's risk management framework is organized using an Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) approach. ERM is a comprehensive and integrated framework for managing Credit Risk, Equity Investment Risk, Operational Risk, Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, Legal Risk, Strategic Risk, Compliance Risk, and Reputational Risk in an effort to balance the Company's risk and return.

To support the Company's sustainable business growth, the Company implements Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) as a guideline for the Company to maintain a balance between its catalytic role and business continuity in executing the mandate given to the Company. The Company consistently updates the entire RAS considering the Company's business conditions, which are increasingly dynamic and competitive, and the RAS is set by the Directors periodically, at least every two years or sooner if needed.

# Prinsip Pertahanan Tiga Lapis

PT SMI menjalankan fungsi manajemen risiko secara komprehensif di seluruh lini organisasi dengan menc gunakan prinsip pertahanan tiga lapis (three lines of defense) sebagai berikut:

1. Lini Pertahanan Pertama (First Line of Defense) Satuan kerja dengan fungsi risk taking (risk taking division) berperan sebagai lini pertahanan pertama dan bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan kegiatan usaha Perseroan dan melakukan pengawasan melekat terhadap: Penerapan Manajemen Risiko pada satuan kerja masing-masing, termasuk kebijakan dan prosedur Manajemen Risiko, serta kepatuhan terhadap limit risiko yang berlaku; Pelaksanaan proses Manajemen Risiko, yaitu melakukan identifikasi risiko, pengukuran risiko, pemantauan risiko, dan pengendalian risiko pada satuan kerja masing-masing; dan Pengelolaan eksposur risiko kegiatan usaha pada satuan kerja masing-masing.

Based on this risk management framework, the Company has established four risk management strategies, namely:

1. Active supervision of the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners and Sharia Supervisory Board
2. Adequacy of Risk Management Policies and Procedures and Determination of Risk Limits
3. Adequacy of the Risk Identification, Measurement, Control, and Monitoring Processes, as well as the Risk Management Information System.
4. Comprehensive Internal Control System

# Three Lines of Defense Principle

PT SMI implements a comprehensive risk management function across all levels of the organization by adopting the Three Lines of Defense principle, which consists of:

1. First Line of Defense

The work unit with the risk taking function (risk taking division) acts as the first line of defense and is responsible for carrying out the Company's business activities and carrying out inherent supervision of: Implementation of Risk Management in each work unit, including Risk Management policies and procedures, as well as compliance with applicable Risk limits; Implementation of the Risk Management process, namely identifying risks, measuring risks, monitoring risks and controlling risks in each work unit; and Management of risk exposure to business activities in each work unit.

2. Lini Pertahanan Kedua (Second Line of Defense)

Satuan kerja dengan fungsi Manajemen Risiko dan fungsi compliance sebagai satuan kerja utama dalam penerapan lini pertahanan kedua melalui fungsi kajian dan pemantauan yang independen untuk memastikan penerapan Manajemen Risiko di Perseroan sesuai Kebijakan Umum Manajemen Risiko, termasuk memastikan penerapan kebijakan dan prosedur Manajemen Risiko, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap limit risiko yang berlaku, serta Memastikan penerapan proses Manajemen Risiko di Perseroan telah berjalan dengan baik sesuai Kebijakan Umum Manajemen Risiko.

Divisi dengan fungsi Manajemen Risiko wajib melakukan review, evaluasi, serta memastikan bahwa penetapan limit risiko dan risiko yang diambil telah teridentifikasi secara tepat, terukur dan dikelola sesuai dengan parameter yang telah disetujui dan dilaporkan kepada manajemen. Fungsi compliance mengelola risiko kepatuhan dan bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan bahwa seluruh ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan dan ketentuan lainnya yang mengikat Perseroan telah disosialisasikan dan dipatuhi oleh seluruh satuan kerja dengan fungsi risk taking (Risk Taking Division) terkait.

3. Lini Pertahanan Ketiga (Third Line of Defense)

Satuan kerja fungsi audit internal berperan sebagai lini pertahanan ketiga (third line of defense) dengan menilai keefektifan proses yang dilakukan pada lini pertahanan pertama dan lini pertahanan kedua untuk memberikan jaminan independen kepada Perseroan bahwa sistem pengendalian internal, Manajemen Risiko, serta proses dan sistem tata kelola telah diterapkan secara efektif.

Satuan kerja fungsi audit internal melakukan penilaian keefektifan dari penerapan Manajemen Risiko, termasuk penerapan dan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan dan prosedur Manajemen Risiko, serta limit risiko yang berlaku, yang telah dilakukan oleh satuan kerja dengan fungsi risk taking (risk taking division), penilaian keefektifan proses yang dilakukan pada lini pertahanan kedua dalam melakukan fungsi kajian dan pemantauan terhadap penerapan Manajemen Risiko, serta penilaian keefektifan dan pemberian jaminan independen pada Perseroan terhadap sistem pengendalian internal, Manajemen Risiko, serta proses dan sistem tata kelola.

Berdasarkan nilai utama manajemen risiko, proses pengelolaan manajemen risiko menjadi tanggung jawab bersama seluruh Insan Perseroan dan kesadaran akan risiko (risk awareness) sudah harus menjadi bagian tak terpisahkan dari budaya Perseroan. Dengan menggunakan pendekatan Three Lines of Defense, fungsi pengelolaan risiko dilakukan secara komprehensif oleh semua lini organisasi.

2. Second Line of Defense

The work unit with Risk Management functions and compliance functions as the main work unit in implementing the second line of defense through independent review and monitoring functions to: Ensure the implementation of Risk Management in the Company in accordance with the General Risk Management Policy, including ensuring the implementation of Risk Management policies and procedures, as well as ensuring compliance with applicable Risk limits; and Ensure that the implementation of the Risk Management process in the Company is running well in accordance with the General Risk Management Policy.

Divisions with Risk Management function are required to review, evaluate and ensure that the determination of risk limits and the risks taken have been identified appropriately, measured and managed in accordance with approved parameters and reported to management. The compliance function manages compliance risk and is responsible for ensuring that all statutory provisions and other provisions that bind the Company have been socialized and complied with by all work units with the relevant risk taking function (Risk Taking Division)

3. Third Line of Defense

The internal audit function work unit acts as the third line of defense by assessing the effectiveness of the processes carried out in the first line of defense and the second line of defense to provide independent assurance to the Company that the internal control system, Risk Management, and governance processes and systems has been implemented effectively.

The internal audit function work unit carries out: Assessment of the effectiveness of the implementation of Risk Management, including implementation and compliance with Risk Management policies and procedures, as well as applicable Risk limits, which has been carried out by the work unit with the risk taking function (risk taking division); Assessment of the effectiveness of the processes carried out in the second line of defense in conducting the function of reviewing and monitoring the implementation of Risk Management; and Evaluation of the effectiveness and provision of independent guarantees to the Company regarding the internal control system, Risk Management, and governance processes and systems

Based on the main value of risk management, the risk management process is a shared responsibility of all Company Personnel and risk awareness must become an inseparable part of the Company's culture. By using the Three Lines of Defense approach, the risk management function is carried out comprehensively by all lines of the organization.

Penerapan prinsip pertahanan tiga lapis dilakukan dengan sosialisasi kepada setiap karyawan akan pentingnya kesadaran atas potensi risiko-risiko dalam pengelolaan kegiatan operasional dan bisnis Perseroan.

Dengan demikian, Jenis-jenis risiko yang dihadapi Perseroan berjumlah 9 (sembilan) Jenis. Perseroan juga melakukan pengelolaan risiko terhadap Risiko Syariah dan Risiko Lingkungan dan Sosial yang merupakan bagian dari taksonomi Risiko Kredit dan Risiko Kepatuhan. [GRI 2-25]

The implementation of the Three Lines of Defense principle includes raising awareness among all employees about the importance of recognizing potential risks in managing the Company's operations and business activities.

# Struktur Tata Kelola Manajemen Risiko

Perseroan berupaya meningkatkan efektivitas manajemen risiko dengan menggunakan pendekatan lini pertahanan tiga lapis dengan tujuan agar pengelolaan risiko dilakukan secara komprehensif di semua lini organisasi. Risk Taking Division berfungsi sebagai First Line of Defense melaksanakan kegiatan-kegiatan usaha Perseroan yang mengandung risiko dalam rangka mencapai sasaran/tujuan Perseroan; Manajemen Risiko berfungsi sebagai Second Line of Defense mengelola risiko secara independen bersama-sama dengan Internal Audit Division sebagai Third Line of Defense yang bertugas melaksanakan risk assurance dan melakukan pengawasan serta evaluasi secara berkala.

# Risk Management Governance Structure

The Company strives to enhance the effectiveness of risk management by utilizing a three-lines of defense approach, ensuring comprehensive risk management across all organizational lines. The Risk Taking Division functions as the First Line of Defense, executing the Company's business activities that involve risk in order to achieve the Company's goals/objectives; Risk Management serves as the Second Line of Defense, independently managing risk along with the Internal Audit Division as the Third Line of Defense, which is tasked with performing risk assurance and conducting regular supervision and evaluation.

## Penilaian Risiko [OJK E.3]

PT SMI melakukan penilaian risiko terkait kegiatan operasional dan bisnis yang dijalankan secara berkala. Penilaian risiko merupakan serangkaian tindakan yang dilaksanakan Direksi untuk mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan menilai risiko yang dihadapi Perseroan untuk mencapai sasaran usaha yang ditetapkan. Proses analisis risiko meliputi estimasi atas signifikansi dampak yang akan timbul, penilaian mengenai tingkat kemungkinan terjadinya risiko dan penetapan langkah yang diperlukan untuk mengatasi risiko tersebut.

Dalam penilaian risiko, Direksi melakukan identifikasi dan kajian terhadap potensi risiko Perseroan terkait aspek-aspek ekonomi, lingkungan dan sosial. Identifikasi risiko dilakukan dengan melaksanakan survei kepada berbagai pemangku kepentingan terkait, sebagai bagian dari penyusunan laporan berkelanjutan. Setelah itu, Direksi menetapkan strategi dan kebijakan penanganan pengelolaan risiko serta melakukan pengawasan atas pelaksanaannya, termasuk pengelolaan risiko untuk aspek-aspek keberlanjutan. Selanjutnya, Direksi mengungkapkan kebijakan yang ditetapkan Perseroan menyangkut pengelolaan risiko dalam Laporan Tahunan dan memberikan hasil analisis risiko yang dilakukan kepada Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan tingkat kebutuhan Perseroan.

Risk Management is responsible for independently executing the risk management governance function and partnering with all business units and operational support units by conducting risk identification, measurement, monitoring, risk management, and information and control systems comprehensively.

The Company has also implemented the Unit Risk and Compliance Manager (URCM) role in the risk management process. The URCM is a key person in each Division tasked as a single point of contact for implementing Risk Management, fulfilling compliance aspects, governance, and follow-up on audit results. The presence of URCM in each division performs a strategic role in aiding internal control improvements, risk mitigation application, and internal audit as well as business process improvements, especially in facing the complexity of the Company's business development.

The Company also continues to enhance the quality of risk governance by adjusting the committees under the Board of Directors to remain aligned with business developments, fostering a risk culture, and strengthening risk awareness to improve the quality of the Company's risk governance processes. Effective as of January 1, 2024, an additional committee has been established under the Board of Directors, namely the Human Capital Management Committee.

## Risk Assessment [OJK E.3]

PT SMI conducts periodic risk assessments related to its operational and business activities. Risk assessment is a series of actions carried out by the Board of Directors in order to identify, analyze and assess the risks faced by the Company to achieve the set business targets. The process of risk analysis includes estimation of the significance of the impact that will arise, an assessment of the level of probability that the risk will occur and determination of the steps needed to address the risk.

In risk assessment, the Board of Directors has the duty to identify and study the potential risks of the Company related to economic, environmental and social aspects. Risk identification is carried out by carrying out a survey of various relevant stakeholders, as part of preparing a sustainability report. After that, the Board of Directors establishes a strategy and policy for handling risk management and supervises its implementation, including risk management for sustainability aspects. The Board of Directors then discloses the policies set by the Company regarding risk management in the Annual Report and provides the results of the risk analysis carried out to the Board of Commissioners in accordance with the level of needs of the Company.

# Menghindari Benturan/Konflik Kepentingan [GRI 2-15]

Prevention of Conflict of Interest [GRI 2-15]

PT SMI menyadari bahwa pembangunan infrastruktur melibatkan interaksi dengan banyak pihak, baik internal maupun eksternal. Tingginya intensitas dengan berbagai pihak memunculkan kemungkinan atas terjadinya benturan/konflik kepentingan dalam pengambilan keputusan pada Perseroan. Untuk itu, Perseroan telah membuat kebijakan bagi Insan Perseroan untuk tidak melakukan aktivitas yang dapat menguntungkan pribadi, keluarga, dan kerabat secara langsung maupun tidak langsung.

Perseroan mendefinisikan benturan kepentingan sebagai situasi di mana seseorang atau Perseroan karena kedudukan atau wewenangnya, memiliki kemampuan, baik secara profesional atau berdasarkan kapasitasnya dengan cara apapun untuk mengeksploitasi kedudukan dan wewenang tersebut demi kepentingan orang atau Perseroan tersebut. Pada tatanan orang-perorangan, konflik kepentingan menimbulkan adanya perbedaan antara kepentingan ekonomis pribadi atau keluarga dengan kepentingan ekonomis Perseroan. Pada tataran Perseroan, konflik kepentingan mempengaruhi pelaksanaan tugas Perseroan yang diamanatkan pemberi tugas secara objektif. Benturan kepentingan mengakibatkan adanya satu pihak yang bekerja untuk dua kepentingan yang berbeda dan saling bertentangan. Secara singkat benturan kepentingan adalah adanya benturan antara kepentingan perseorangan dengan kewajiban umum atau kewajiban profesional.

Berkaitan dengan benturan kepentingan, PT SMI telah menetapkan kebijakan umum yakni seluruh pihak yang memiliki potensi benturan kepentingan dilarang mengikuti seluruh tahapan pengambilan keputusan. Ketentuan ini berlaku pada seluruh jenjang jabatan, hingga ke level anggota Direksi, anggota Dewan Komisaris, hingga Pemegang Saham. Pemegang Saham tidak diperkenankan mencampuri kegiatan operasional Perseroan yang menjadi tanggung jawab Direksi sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

The Company recognizes that infrastructure development involves interactions with numerous parties, both internally and externally. The high frequency of interactions with various parties raises the possibility of conflicts of interest in decision-making within the Company. Therefore, the Company has established policies for all Company personnel to refrain from engaging in activities that could benefit themselves, their families, or relatives, either directly or indirectly.

The Company defines conflict of interest as a situation where an individual or the Company, due to their position or authority, has the ability—whether professionally or based on their capacity—to exploit such position and authority for personal or corporate gain. At an individual level, a conflict of interest arises when there is a discrepancy between personal or family economic interests and the Company's economic interests. At a corporate level, a conflict of interest can affect the objectivity of the Company's decision-making in fulfilling its mandated duties. A conflict of interest results in an individual or entity working for two opposing interests. In summary, a conflict of interest occurs when personal interests conflict with general or professional obligations.

To prevent conflicts of interest, PT SMI has established a general policy stating that any party with a potential conflict of interest is prohibited from participating in any stage of the decision-making process. This policy applies across all levels of the organization, including members of the Board of Directors, the Board of Commissioners, and Shareholders. Furthermore, Shareholders are not permitted to interfere in the Company's operational activities, which fall under the responsibility of the Board of Directors, in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations.

Adapun Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan Karyawan wajib mematuhi peraturan terkait benturan kepentingan sebagai berikut:

1. Dilarang memangku jabatan rangkap sebagai anggota Direksi pada BUMN, BUMD, badan usaha milik swasta, dan jabatan lain yang dapat menimbulkan benturan kepentingan.
2. Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi wajib melaporkan kepada Perseroan mengenai kepemilikan sahamnya dan/atau keluarganya pada perusahaan lain.
3. Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi tidak dibenarkan mempunyai kepentingan yang dapat mengganggu kemampuan untuk melaksanakan tugas secara mandiri dan kritis dalam hubungan satu sama lain.
4. Dilarang melakukan transaksi yang mempunyai benturan kepentingan dan mengambil keuntungan pribadi dari kegiatan perusahaan yang bersangkutan, selain gaji dan fasilitas yang diterimanya sebagai Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, yang ditentukan oleh RUPS.
5. Antara para anggota Direksi maupun anggota Dewan Komisaris, tidak boleh ada hubungan keluarga sedarah sampai derajat ketiga, baik menurut garis lurus maupun garis ke samping atau hubungan semenda (menantu atau ipar).
6. Semua Karyawan tidak boleh merangkap jabatan lain pada perusahaan lain atau memiliki usaha yang dapat menimbulkan benturan kepentingan secara langsung maupun tidak langsung dengan kepentingan Perseroan, kecuali apabila telah mendapatkan pengawasan atau izin tertulis dari Perseroan.
7. Dewan Komisaris, Direksi dan Karyawan wajib dengan iktikad baik menyampaikan adanya transaksi atau hubungan material yang berpotensi menimbulkan benturan kepentingan kepada Pejabat Etika.

The Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors must comply with regulations related to conflicts of interest as follows:

1. Prohibited from holding concurrent positions as members of the Board of Directors in state-owned enterprises (SOEs), regional-owned enterprises (ROEs), private enterprises, and other positions that may cause conflicts of interest.
2. The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are required to report to the Company regarding their and/or their family's shareholdings in other companies.
3. The Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are not allowed to have interests that could interfere with their ability to perform their duties independently and critically in relation to each other.
4. Prohibited from conducting transactions that have conflicts of interest and from profiting personally from the Company's activities, other than the salary and facilities received as members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors, as determined by the General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPS).
5. Members of the Board of Directors or Board of Commissioners shall not have any familial relationships up to the third degree, either by bloodline or by marriage (in-laws or siblings-in-law).
6. All employees are prohibited from holding other positions in other companies or owning businesses that could directly or indirectly cause conflicts of interest with the Company's interests, unless they have been assigned or given written permission by the Company.
7. The Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and employees must in good faith report any transactions or material relationships that have the potential to cause conflicts of interest to the Ethics Officer.

# Etika Usaha dan Tata Perilaku
[GRI 2-23, 2-24]
Business Ethics and Code of Conduct [GRI 2-23, 2-24]

PT SMI berkomitmen untuk melaksanakan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik dalam menjalankan usaha. Komitmen tersebut antara lain direalisasikan dengan menerbitkan Peraturan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi No. PER-02/SMI/DK/1221 dan PD-024/SMI/1221 tentang Etika Usaha dan Tata Perilaku (Code of Conduct) tertanggal 31 Desember 2021. Etika Usaha dan Tata Perilaku merupakan panduan yang berisi kewajiban yang harus dilaksanakan dan larangan yang harus dihindari sebagai penjabaran pelaksanaan prinsip-prinsip GCG yang terdiri dari Transparansi, Akuntabilitas, Tanggung Jawab, Kemandirian, serta Kewajaran dan Kesetaraan.

Perseroan berharap penerapan Etika Usaha dan Tata Perilaku mampu menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang profesional, jujur, terbuka, peduli, dan tanggap terhadap setiap kegiatan PT SMI dan Pemangku Kepentingan. Di antara penerapan panduan tersebut adalah pelelangan barang gratifikasi yang dikumpulkan Perseroan.

Adapun butir-butir aturan etika pokok yang terkandung dalam Etika Usaha dan Tata Perilaku adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Larangan Pemberian dan Penerimaan Hadiah serta Donasi

PT SMI secara konsisten melakukan penerapan larangan pemberian maupun penerimaan hadiah dan gratifikasi dalam bentuk apapun, baik oleh pihak internal maupun eksternal Perseroan. Dengan adanya larangan ini diharapkan dapat menegakkan independensi setiap pengambilan keputusan dan meningkatkan integritas Perseroan yang pada akhirnya meningkatkan kepercayaan pemangku kepentingan. Untuk itu, PT SMI telah menetapkan berbagai aturan terkait dengan pemberian maupun penerimaan hadiah, sebagaimana diatur pada Prosedur Pengendalian Gratifikasi PT SMI.

2. Kebijakan Benturan Kepentingan pada Proses Investasi dan Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa

PT SMI berkomitmen untuk menjaga integritas dan transparansi dalam setiap tahap proses pengadaan barang dan jasa, serta investasi yang dilakukan oleh Perseroan. Kami menyadari bahwa adanya potensi benturan kepentingan dapat mempengaruhi objektivitas dan keadilan dalam pengambilan keputusan, yang pada akhirnya berpotensi merugikan Perseroan dan pemangku kepentingan. Oleh karena itu, kebijakan benturan kepentingan dalam proses investasi dan pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa menjadi bagian integral dari upaya kami untuk mencegah praktik yang tidak etis, serta memastikan semua keputusan didasarkan pada prinsip-prinsip tata kelola yang baik (Good Corporate Governance/GCG).

PT SMI is committed to implementing Good Corporate Governance (GCG) in its business operations. This commitment is reflected in the issuance of the Joint Regulation of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors No. PER-02/SMI/DK/1221 and PD-024/SMI/1221 concerning Business Ethics and Code of Conduct, dated December 31, 2021. The Business Ethics and Code of Conduct serve as a guideline outlining the obligations to be fulfilled and the prohibitions to be avoided, providing a detailed interpretation of GCG principles, which include Transparency, Accountability, Responsibility, Independence, Fairness, and Equality.

The Company aims for the implementation of the Business Ethics and Code of Conduct to foster a professional, honest, open, caring, and responsive work environment in all PT SMI activities and stakeholder engagements. One example of its application is the auctioning of gratifications received by the Company to ensure ethical business practices.

The main ethical rules contained in the Business Ethics and Code of Conduct are as follows:

1. Prohibition of Giving and Receiving Gifts and Donations

PT SMI consistently applies the prohibition of giving or receiving gifts and gratuities in any form, both by internal and external parties of the Company. With this prohibition, it is expected to uphold the independence of every decision-making and improve the integrity of the Company, ultimately increasing stakeholder trust. Therefore, PT SMI has established various regulations regarding the giving and receiving of gifts, as stipulated in the PT SMI's Gratification Control Procedure.

2. Conflict of Interest Policy in Investment Processes and Procurement of Goods and/or Services

PT SMI is committed to maintaining integrity and transparency at every stage of the procurement process for goods and services, as well as in the company's investment activities. We recognize that potential conflicts of interest may affect objectivity and fairness in decision-making, which could ultimately be detrimental to the company and its stakeholders. Therefore, the conflict of interest policy in the investment and procurement processes for goods and/or services is an integral part of our efforts to prevent unethical practices and ensure that all decisions are based on the principles of Good Corporate Governance (GCG).

# Penerapan Kebijakan Benturan Kepentingan

## Definisi Benturan Kepentingan

Benturan kepentingan merujuk pada situasi di mana kepentingan pribadi, keluarga, atau pihak lain yang terhubung dengan individu yang terlibat dalam pengambilan keputusan dapat mempengaruhi objektivitas dan integritas keputusan yang diambil. Perseroan menekankan bahwa setiap karyawan, pejabat, dan pihak terkait dalam proses investasi dan pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa harus menjaga jarak dari situasi yang dapat menyebabkan konflik kepentingan.

## Identifikasi dan Penanganan Benturan Kepentingan

Sebelum proses pengadaan atau investasi dimulai, setiap individu yang terlibat diharuskan untuk mengungkapkan potensi benturan kepentingan yang mungkin ada. Jika ada indikasi benturan kepentingan, Perseroan akan mengambil langkah-langkah yang diperlukan untuk mencegah pihak yang terlibat dalam proses pengambilan keputusan yang tidak objektif. Hal ini dapat meliputi pengunduran diri dari posisi pengambilan keputusan atau penunjukan individu yang tidak memiliki konflik kepentingan untuk menggantikan posisi tersebut.

## Transparansi dan Akuntabilitas

Perseroan menerapkan prinsip transparansi yang tinggi dalam setiap keputusan yang diambil terkait investasi dan pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa. Setiap keputusan, mulai dari evaluasi hingga pelaksanaan, harus terdokumentasi dengan jelas dan dapat diakses oleh pemangku kepentingan yang berwenang. Dokumentasi ini akan memastikan bahwa setiap keputusan diambil berdasarkan kriteria yang adil dan objektif, tanpa ada pengaruh dari pihak yang memiliki benturan kepentingan.

## Pendidikan dan Sosialisasi Kebijakan Benturan Kepentingan

Perseroan melakukan sosialisasi yang berkelanjutan mengenai kebijakan benturan kepentingan kepada seluruh karyawan dan mitra yang terlibat dalam proses pengadaan dan investasi. Hal ini bertujuan untuk memastikan pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai potensi benturan kepentingan dan cara-cara untuk menghindarinya. Pelatihan ini diselenggarakan secara rutin dan wajib diikuti oleh pihak yang terlibat dalam pengambilan keputusan penting di Perseroan.

## Pelaporan dan Pengawasan

Perseroan menyediakan saluran pelaporan yang aman dan terbuka bagi karyawan dan mitra untuk melaporkan potensi benturan kepentingan yang mereka temui dalam proses pengadaan atau investasi. Setiap laporan akan ditindaklanjuti secara objektif dan sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku. # Implementation of the Conflict of Interest Policy

## Definition of Conflict of Interest

A conflict of interest refers to a situation in which personal, familial, or other external interests connected to an individual involved in decision-making may affect the objectivity and integrity of the decisions made. The Company emphasizes that every employee, official, and related party involved in the investment and procurement processes for goods and/or services must maintain distance from situations that could lead to conflicts of interest.

## Identification and Handling of Conflicts of Interest

Before the procurement or investment process begins, every individual involved is required to disclose any potential conflicts of interest. If indications of a conflict of interest arise, the Company will take the necessary steps to prevent the involvement of affected individuals in decision-making processes that may lack objectivity. These measures may include voluntary withdrawal from decision-making positions or the appointment of individuals without conflicts of interest to assume the role.

## Transparency and Accountability

The Company upholds a high level of transparency in all decisions related to investments and the procurement of goods and/or services. Every decision, from evaluation to execution, must be clearly documented and accessible to authorized stakeholders. This documentation ensures that all decisions are made based on fair and objective criteria, without influence from parties with conflicts of interest.

## Education and Dissemination of the Conflict of Interest Policy

The Company continuously conducts awareness programs regarding the conflict of interest policy for all employees and partners involved in procurement and investment processes. This initiative aims to ensure a thorough understanding of potential conflicts of interest and the appropriate measures to prevent them. These training sessions are conducted regularly and are mandatory for individuals involved in critical decision-making within the Company.

## Reporting and Oversight

The Company provides a secure and open reporting channel for employees and partners to report any potential conflicts of interest encountered during procurement or investment processes. Every report will be addressed objectively and in accordance with applicable procedures. The Company's Ethics Officer actively oversees the implementation of this policy and provides the final decision in handling alleged violations related to conflicts of interest.

# Whistleblowing System [GRI 2-26]
## Whistleblowing System [GRI 2-26]

PT SMI berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan efektivitas pengendalian internal yang bertujuan untuk mengurangi atau menghindari tindakan pelanggaran di Perseroan.

Untuk mewujudkan hal tersebut, pada tahun 2022, Perseroan menyusun dan menerbitkan Petunjuk Teknis Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran (Whistleblowing System WBS). Perseroan meyakini implementasi WBS menjadi salah satu metode pendeteksian dini atas terjadinya pelanggaran, sekaligus mendorong upaya mewujudkan budaya organisasi yang lebih transparan dan akuntabel, mendorong kinerja organisasi, dan melindungi para pemangku kepentingan. Dengan demikian, pelaksanaan tugas pokok dan fungsi organisasi dapat tercapai dengan baik, efektif dan efisien, baik dalam jangka pendek maupun jangka panjang, sehingga reputasi PT SMI semakin meningkat, baik di dalam maupun luar negeri.

Petunjuk Teknis mengatur secara lengkap mulai dari prinsip-prinsip pelaporan pelanggaran, ketentuan pelaporan pelanggaran termasuk di dalamnya tentang komitmen penerapan WBS, perlindungan pelapor, pengelola WBS, mekanisme penanganan pelaporan, media pelaporan, serta proses tindak lanjut atas pengaduan pelanggaran melalui saluran/media WBS. Selain itu, juga terdapat pembahasan tentang sosialisasi dan evaluasi, penghargaan dan sanksi, serta pemulihan nama baik.

Selama tahun 2024, PT SMI tidak menerima adanya laporan pengaduan pelanggaran yang masuk melalui dari saluran Whistleblowing System PT SMI. Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan menerima 1 (satu) laporan melalui WBS dan telah selesai ditindaklanjuti pada bulan Juni 2024 dengan hasil investigasi diyakini tidak terjadi. Sementara itu, pada tahun 2022, tercatat 1 (satu) laporan diterima dan telah selesai ditindaklanjuti pada tahun 2023. PT SMI menjamin seluruh laporan yang disampaikan oleh Pelapor bersifat rahasia dan ditindaklanjuti sesuai dengan peraturan internal maupun perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

PT SMI is committed to enhancing the effectiveness of internal control to mitigate or prevent violations within the Company.

In pursuit of this objective, in 2022, the Company developed and issued the Technical Guidelines for the Whistleblowing System (WBS). PT SMI believes that implementing the WBS serves as an early detection mechanism for violations while fostering a more transparent and accountable organizational culture, improving organizational performance, and safeguarding stakeholders. Through this initiative, the Company's core functions and operational goals can be achieved effectively and efficiently in both the short and long term, further strengthening PT SMI's reputation domestically and internationally.

Technical Guidelines comprehensively regulate all aspects, including the principles of violation reporting, reporting provisions—covering the commitment to implementing the Whistleblowing System (WBS), whistleblower protection, WBS management, reporting handling mechanisms, reporting channels, and the follow-up process for complaints submitted through the WBS channels. Additionally, the guidelines also address dissemination and evaluation, rewards and sanctions, as well as reputation restoration.

Throughout 2024, PT SMI did not receive any violation reports through the PT SMI Whistleblowing System (WBS). In 2023, the Company received one report through WBS, which was fully addressed and concluded in June 2024, with the investigation determining that no violation had occurred. Meanwhile, in 2022, 1 (one) report was recorded and was fully resolved in 2023. PT SMI ensures that all reports submitted by whistleblowers are kept confidential and are handled in accordance with internal regulations as well as prevailing laws and regulations.

# BERTRANSFORMASI MENJADI DEVELOPMENT FINANCE INSTITUTION UNTUK PEMBANGUNAN INFRASTRUKTUR TRANSFORMING INTO A DEVELOPMENT FINANCE INSTITUTION FOR INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT

Pada usianya ke-15 tahun, PT SMI terus menyempurnakan perannya sebagai *Special Mission Vehicle* di bawah Kementerian Keuangan, yakni mendorong pemerataan pembangunan infrastruktur berkelanjutan di seluruh daerah di Indonesia. Di penghujung tahun 2024, Perseroan tengah bertransformasi menjadi *Development Finance Institution (DFI)* untuk meningkatkan kualitas pembiayaan publik. Proses transformasi tersebut akan membuat peran Perseroan dalam memberikan pembiayaan akan sedikit banyak menyerupai World Bank.

Dalam praktik, jika World Bank sebagai lembaga keuangan internasional memberikan pembiayaan kepada negara-negara yang membutuhkan bantuan pembiayaan, maka SMI sebagai DFI akan memberikan pembiayaan untuk pembangunan infrastruktur kepada yang membutuhkan, tetapi lingkupnya lebih kecil yaitu kepada Pemerintah Daerah (Pemda) di Indonesia.

Walau memberikan pembiayaan kepada Pemda, PT SMI tetap memberikan pembiayaan ke Badan Usaha karena di situlah peran Perseroan dalam konteks untuk membangun infrastruktur di Indonesia. Dengan demikian, sebagai DFI, Perseroan akan mendorong dan memaksimalkan proporsi pembiayaan publik sehingga antara pembiayaan Badan Usaha maupun publik itu bisa relatif seimbang.

Perseroan mencatat hingga saat ini dari total 546 Pemda di Indonesia, baru 111 Pemda yang telah tersentuh pembiayaan PT SMI. Porsi pembiayaan Perseroan juga sebagian besar terdiri dari Badan Usaha dan bukan Pemda. Per 31 Desember 2024, pembiayaan *outstanding PT SMI* ke Pemda adalah sebesar Rp21,61 triliun, sedangkan pembiayaan *outstanding* ke Badan Usaha lebih besar yakni Rp69,02 triliun. Mengingat masih timpangnya rasio antara pembiayaan ke Pemda dan Badan Usaha, ke depan sebagai DFI, Perseroan menargetkan perbandingannya menjadi satu banding satu.

PT SMI tidak mematok target penyelesaian transformasi menjadi DFI, karena prosesnya akan terus berjalan seiring dengan peningkatan pembiayaan ke infrastruktur publik. Namun demikian, untuk mengoptimalkan perannya sebagai DFI, Perseroan akan melakukan klastersiasi kepada 546 Pemda di Indonesia menjadi empat kelompok klaster sesuai kemampuan fiskal dan kondisi sosial ekonomi masing-masing Pemda. As it reaches its 15th anniversary, PT SMI continues to refine its role as a Special Mission Vehicle under the Ministry of Finance, driving equitable and sustainable infrastructure development across Indonesia. By the end of 2024, the Company is undergoing a transformation into a Development Finance Institution (DFI) to enhance the quality of public financing. The transformation process will make the Company's role in providing financing to be more or less like the World Bank.

In practice, while the World Bank, as an international financial institution, provides financing assistance to countries in need, PT SMI, as a DFI will provide infrastructure financing to those in need, but on a smaller scale, specifically targeting Regional Governments (Pemda) in Indonesia.

Despite increasing its financing to Regional Governments, PT SMI continues to extend financing to Business Entities, as this aligns with the Company's role in infrastructure development in Indonesia. As a DFI, the Company aims to maximize and balance the proportion of public financing, ensuring a more equitable distribution between Business Entities and public sector financing.

As of now, out of a total of 546 Regional Governments in Indonesia, only 111 have received financing from PT SMI. The Company's financing allocation remains predominantly directed toward Business Entities rather than Regional Governments. As of December 31, 2024, PT SMI's outstanding financing to Regional Governments amounted to IDR21.61 trillion, whereas outstanding financing to Business Entities was significantly higher at IDR69.02 trillion. Given this imbalance in the financing ratio between Regional Governments and Business Entities, the Company, as a Development Finance Institution (DFI), aims to achieve a one-to-one ratio in the future.

PT SMI does not set a fixed timeline for completing its transformation into a DFI, as the process will continue to evolve alongside the expansion of public infrastructure financing. However, to optimize its role as a Development Finance Institution (DFI), the Company will categorize the 546 Regional Governments in Indonesia into four clusters based on their fiscal capacity and socio-economic conditions. Transisi energi tersebut diharapkan mampu meningkatkan efisiensi penggunaan energi yang lebih ramah lingkungan sehingga berdampak positif terhadap aspek sosial, ekonomi, dan lingkungan yang bermuara dengan terciptanya pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkesinambungan.

## Menerima Perluasan Mandat sebagai Country Platform Manager ETM untuk Mempercepat Transisi Energi Bersih

Pemerintah menunjuk PT SMI menjadi Country Platform Manager pada penerapan Energi Transition Mechanism (ETM) atau Mekanisme Transisi Energi, yaitu program peningkatan pembangunan infrastruktur energi dan percepatan transisi energi menuju emisi nol bersih/Net Zero Emission (NZE) dengan prinsip adil (just) dan terjangkau (affordable) pada tahun 2060 atau lebih cepat. Indonesia memerlukan ETM karena ekonominya diproyeksikan akan terus tumbuh dan ditargetkan menjadi negara maju pada 2045. Untuk itu, Indonesia membutuhkan energi yang sangat besar tetapi tidak boleh berdampak negatif terhadap lingkungan.
