The transformation into a DFI further solidifies PT SMI's long-standing commitment to accelerating national infrastructure development while strengthening its role in building sustainable infrastructure with continuously considering sustainability aspects. For PT SMI, the transformation into a DFI presents its own challenges, particularly as it is being carried out in 2024, amid complex global and national economic conditions, which are projected to persist into 2025. PT SMI's achievements in accelerating economic recovery were marked by its ability to generate a multiplier effect through tasks beyond its core infrastructure business.

The Company's optimism also refers to the positive developments in fulfilling its role as Country Platform Manager for the Energy Transition Mechanism (ETM), which is responsible for channeling the Government's fiscal support within the framework of funding and financing the energy transition in Indonesia. The energy transition is expected to enhance the efficiency of environmentally friendly energy use, generating positive impacts on social, economic, and environmental aspects. Ultimately, this transition aims to foster sustainable economic growth.

## Receiving an Expanded Mandate as Country Platform Manager for ETM to Accelerate Clean Energy Transition

The Government of Indonesia has appointed PT SMI as the Country Platform Manager for the implementation of the Energy Transition Mechanism (ETM)—a program aimed at enhancing energy infrastructure development and accelerating the transition to net-zero emissions (NZE) by 2060 or earlier through a just and affordable approach. Indonesia requires ETM because its economy is projected to continue growing, with a target of becoming a developed nation by 2045. To achieve this, Indonesia will need a significant amount of energy, but without causing negative environmental impacts.

Realizing the Company's Vision and Mission of Accelerating Infrastructure Development [GRI 201-1, 203-2]

PT SMI has a vision to become a sustainable development agent to enhance the nation's welfare, supported by three missions: to serve as a strong catalyst in improving national welfare, to be a trusted partner in realizing inclusive and sustainable national development aspirations, and to be a leading driver in accelerating infrastructure development.

To achieve this vision and mission, the Company continuously innovates its financial products by designing financing schemes for infrastructure projects. These innovations aim to transform unbankable infrastructure projects into bankable ones. Aligned with good corporate governance implementation, PT SMI ensures that all infrastructure financing is conducted prudently and responsibly, with a thorough risk assessment and mitigation strategy. [GRI 3-3]

Once an infrastructure project financing scheme is established, PT SMI proceeds with its implementation, either by using its internal funds or by partnering with Business Entities, both banks as well as other financial institutions to establish a financing syndication. The Company then structures financing packages tailored to each project's risk profile and repayment sources, effectively bridging creditors (banks and other financial institutions) with infrastructure projects, encouraging active participation in Indonesia's infrastructure development.

Currently, PT SMI adopts three financing schemes, namely Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Non-State Budget Investment Financing (PINA), and a blending of financing from multilateral agencies, the government and/or philanthropic sources (blended finance). Furthermore, to fulfill its mandate of providing the best and most responsible financing solutions for infrastructure projects, the Company has defined 6 (six) catalytic mandates to realize its vision and mission.

# Financing or Investment Aligned with Sustainable Finance [OJK F.3]

As a financial services institution specializing in infrastructure financing, PT SMI is required to implement Regulation of the Financial Services Authority No. 51/POJK.03/2017 on the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies (POJK Sustainable Finance). This regulation mandates that financial institutions must develop financing or investment programs focused on projects or instruments aligned with sustainable finance principles. The criteria for such sustainable financing or investment programs include:

1. Prioritizing efficiency and effectiveness in the use of natural resources to ensure sustainability.
2. Preventing, limiting, reducing, or mitigating environmental damage, pollution, waste, ecosystem degradation, and social inequality.
3. Providing solutions for communities facing climate change impacts.

# Pengungkapan Kerangka Governansi, Pengelolaan dan Pengendalian Aspek Perpajakan

Sebagai bagian dari Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN), PT SMI berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi terhadap pembangunan melalui ketaatan dalam pembayaran pajak. Selama tahun 2024, Perseroan telah mematuhi semua peraturan dan memenuhi kewajiban pajak sesuai dengan hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku. Dengan demikian, Perseroan tidak menerima peringatan apapun atau sanksi signifikan terkait dengan perpajakan sampai dengan 31 Desember 2024.

Pengelolaan pajak di PT SMI dilakukan oleh Divisi Akuntansi dan Administrasi Aset (DAA), di bawah Direktur Operasional dan Keuangan, yang sekaligus merupakan badan tata kelola tertinggi yang secara resmi meninjau dan menyetujui strategi pajak Perseroan. Sebagai wajib pajak, Perseroan berkomitmen untuk menghindari pelanggaran peraturan perpajakan agar tidak terkena saksi administrasi, baik berupa sanksi dengan administrasi, sanksi bunga, sanksi kenaikan, serta sanksi pidana atau kurungan.

Berkaitan dengan laporan pajak, Perseroananya beroperasi di Indonesia dan tidak memiliki cabang atau kantor operasional di luar negeri. Dengan demikian, laporan perpajakananya dilakukan untuk Indonesia. Per 31 Desember 2024, Perseroan telah membayarkan pajak penghasilan, pajak badan, dan retribusi kepada Pemerintah sebesar Rp374,01 miliar, turun dibandingkan tahun 2023 dengan pembayaran pajak sebesar Rp404,26 miliar. Penurunan nilai Pajak Penghasilan dipengaruhi oleh nilai Kerugian Penurunan Nilai Wajar Aset deposito, efek-efek, piutang usaha dan piutang bunga yang nilainya jauh lebih rendah pada periode 2024, sebesar minus Rp11,04 miliar, dibandingkan pada periode 2023 yang lalu, sebesar Rp38,50 miliar.

## Distribusi Nilai Ekonomi

Berdasarkan pencapaian kinerja ekonomi PT SMI sebagaimana disampaikan dalam neraca audited, maka distribusi nilai ekonomi Perseroan yaitu nilai ekonomi langsung yang dihasilkan, nilai ekonomi yang didistribusikan, dan nilai ekonomi yang ditahan, dapat dihitung. Nilai ekonomi langsung yang dihasilkan adalah sejumlah pendapatan yang diperoleh dari hasil kegiatan bisnis Perseroan. Sedangkan nilai ekonomi yang didistribusikan merupakan sejumlah pengeluaran yang didistribusikan sebagai bentuk kontribusi Perseroan dalam meningkatkan laju pertumbuhan ekonomi dan kesejahteraan para pemangku kepentingan, seperti pembayaran gaji, pajak, dividen, pembayaran untuk pemasok, maupun realisasi dana untuk masyarakat sebagai salah satu bentuk perwujudan Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL). Adapun nilai ekonomi yang disimpan adalah selisih antara nilai ekonomi yang dihasilkan dikurangi dengan nilai ekonomi yang didistribusikan, yang digunakan untuk pengembangan usaha Perseroan. ## Economic Value Distributed

Based on PT SMI's audited financial performance, the distribution of economic value—including direct economic value generated, economic value distributed, and economic value retained—can be calculated. Direct economic value generated refers to the total revenue earned from the Company's business activities. Distributed economic value represents expenditures allocated to stakeholders, reflecting PT SMI's contribution to economic growth and stakeholder well-being. This includes salary payments, taxes, dividends, supplier payments, and community funding under the Social and Environmental Responsibility (CSR) program. Economic value retained is the difference between the economic value generated and the economic value distributed, which is allocated for the Company's business development. [GRI 201-1]

## Portfolio Khusus Proyek Green Climate Fund (GCF) [OJK F.3]

Perseroan berkomitmen untuk mendorong pencapaian SDGs dalam pembangunan infrastruktur yang dapat memberikan manfaat terhadap aspek ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan. Komitmen tersebut antara lain diwujudkan dengan Pembiayaan Green Climate Fund (GCF). Implementasi komitmen telah menjadikan PT SMI sebagai entitas pertama di Asia Tenggara yang mendapatkan akreditasi dari GCF sehingga memungkinkan Perseroan selaku entitas terakreditasi (accredited entity) untuk mengakses pendanaan dalam rangka mendukung proyek-proyek terkait mitigasi dan adaptasi perubahan iklim.

## Kriteria Proyek Investasi Green Climate Fund (GCF)

1. Potensi dampak proyek: Potensi untuk berkontribusi terhadap pencapaian tujuan-tujuan GCF.
2. Potensi pergeseran paradigma (Paradigm Shift): Dampak jangka panjang atas investasi GCF.
3. Potensi pembangunan berkelanjutan: Manfaat tambahan, ekonomi, sosial, lingkungan.
4. Kebutuhan penerima: Kerentanan dan kebutuhan pembiayaan dari penerima manfaat.
5. Kepemilikan negara: Kapasitas implementasi proyek, keselarasan dengan strategi dan kebijakan nasional.
6. Efisiensi dan efektivitas: Efektivitas dan efisiensi atas biaya proyek mitigasi perubahan iklim.

## Sektor yang Dapat Didanai

1. Mitigasi Perubahan Iklim
2. Pembangkitan dan akses energi.
3. Transportasi.
4. Kehutanan dan pemanfaatan lahan.
5. Bangunan, perkotaan, industri, dan appliances.

Pada tahun 2024, PT SMI telah menyampaikan concept note dan proposal Project Preparation Facility (PPF) kepada GCF untuk memasilitasi program "Climate Finance Facility to Support Energy Transition in Indonesia" yang telah mendapatkan No-Objection Letter (NOL) dari Kementerian Keuangan.

## Manfaat Ekonomi dari Proyek-Proyek Dukungan

PT SMI berkomitmen untuk mendorong terciptanya peningkatan kesejahteraan sosial dan menciptakan dampak ekonomi melalui multiplier effect terhadap indikator sosial dan ekonomi. Dalam rangka mendukung komitmen tersebut, Perseroan senantiasa menghadirkan prinsip berkelanjutan

## Special Portfolio for Green Climate Fund (GCF) Projects [OJK F.3]

PT SMI is committed to advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by financing infrastructure projects that generate economic, social, and environmental benefits. One of the key initiatives supporting this commitment is the Green Climate Fund (GCF) financing program. Through this initiative, PT SMI became the first accredited entity in Southeast Asia to receive GCF accreditation. This accreditation enables the Company to access GCF funding, supporting projects focused on climate change mitigation and adaptation.

## Green Climate Fund (GCF) Project Criteria

1. Potential impact of the project: Potential to contribute to the achievement of GCF goals.
2. Potential paradigm shift (Paradigm Shift): Long-term impact on GCF investments.
3. Potential for sustainable development: Additional benefits, economic, social, environmental.
4. Recipient's need: Vulnerability and financing needs of beneficiaries.
5. State ownership: Project implementation capacity, alignment with national strategies and policies.
6. Efficiency and effectiveness: Cost effectiveness and efficiency of climate change mitigation projects.

## Eligible Sectors

1. Climate Changes Mitigation
2. Energy generation and access.
3. Transportation.
4. Forestry and land usage.
5. Building, urban, industrial, and appliances.

In 2024, PT SMI submitted a concept note and proposal for the Project Preparation Facility (PPF) to the Green Climate Fund (GCF) to facilitate the "Climate Finance Facility to Support Energy Transition in Indonesia" program, which has received a No-Objection Letter (NOL) from the Ministry of Finance.

PT SMI is committed to fostering social welfare improvements and generating economic impact through the multiplier effect on social and economic indicators. To support this commitment, the Company consistently integrates sustainability principles into all business activities through

Under this assignment, PT SMI will provide transition financing and support to support a just transition towards clean energy and low-carbon economic development. The energy transition scheme includes accelerating the retirement process of coal-fired power plants and supporting the development of renewable energy projects.

In the long term, ETM potentially impacts the Indonesian economy positively. The transition towards renewable energy sources and the decarbonization of the energy sector can create new employment opportunities in the renewable energy industry. This can contribute to economic growth and support Indonesia's energy ambitions.

## Sinergi Untuk Mencapai Tujuan Bersama

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak dalam bidang pembiayaan infrastruktur, PT SMI memahami bahwa pembangunan berkelanjutan membutuhkan pendekatan yang holistik dan kolaboratif. Tidak hanya dengan pemerintah sebagai pemangku kepentingan utama, tetapi juga dengan sektor swasta, lembaga keuangan internasional, serta masyarakat lokal. Kolaborasi ini diharapkan tidak hanya berfokus pada pencapaian tujuan finansial, tetapi juga memberikan kontribusi nyata bagi pembangunan sosial dan ekonomi negara.

As an illustration, from an environmental cost perspective, the early retirement of CFPPs could avoid 500 million tons of $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ emissions from 2023 to 2043. Also, costs arising from acute respiratory illnesses amounting to USD170.1 billion (IDR2,608 trillion) or equivalent to 114,622 mortality cases may be avoided. This equates to the country avoiding mortality costs of USD7.8 billion or equivalent to 5,458 mortality cases per year.

Repurposing of FPPs into new renewable energy power plants could also drive economic growth for impacted provinces through investments in this new sector. Assuming CFPPs slated for decommissioning will be replaced by solar PV plants, there is potential for added economic value in West Java province of USD65.9 million (IDR1 trillion), Central Java USD472.8 million (IDRR7.3 trillion), East Java USD86.4 million (IDRR1.3 trillion) and Banten USD89.5 million (IDR1.4 trillion). Additionally, this new industry could absorb green jobs around 5,067 workforces for West Java, 38,179 for Central Java, 5,265 for East Java, and 6,548 for Banten province.

On the other side, the implementation of the ETM may generate benefits amounting to USD170.9 billion (IDR2,619 trillion) from 2023 to 2043. These benefits hold significantly more value compared to the associated costs, which range from USD18.2 billion to USD20.4 billion (IDR278.9 trillion – IDR312.7 trillion) over the same period. Hence, beyond environmental sustainability, executing the ETM is imperative given the substantial economic gains it is poised to unlock.

## Financial Implications, Risks, and Opportunities Arising from Climate Change

Climate change and global warming are significant global challenges, including for Indonesia, requiring collective action to mitigate their effects. The urgency for climate adaptation and mitigation continues to rise as negative impacts become more evident. The impacts of climate change include extreme weather conditions, rising temperatures, and increasingly unpredictable rainfall patterns. Rainfall is becoming heavier and more erratic, while dry seasons are lasting longer than usual, leading to crop failures and other environmental disruptions. Beyond causing environmental disasters, climate change also has negative consequences for human life and other living organisms. [GRI 3-3]

As an infrastructure financing institution, climate change directly affects PT SMI, particularly in relation to self-financed infrastructure development projects. Similarly, borrowers face the same risks, which could hinder their financial performance and affect loan repayment capabilities. Recognizing these risks, PT SMI strives to adjust its operations to address the global environmental challenge of climate change.

To achieve these objectives, PT SMI has taken concrete steps to develop a framework and methodology for managing climate risks, tailored to the company's business characteristics. This framework considers guidance from the Climate Risk Management and Scenario Analysis (CRMS) issued by the Financial Services Authority (OJK) as a key reference, which has also incorporated aspects of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) recommendations.

The TCFD framework categorizes climate change risks into two main types: physical risks and transition risks. Physical risks include extreme weather events such as droughts or floods, as well as long-term impacts like the increase

peningkatan suhu rata-rata global. Sementara itu, risiko transisi mencakup peralihan global menuju ekonomi rendah karbon, perubahan regulasi, dan inovasi dalam efisiensi energi.

in global average temperatures. Transition risks refer to the global shift toward a low-carbon economy, including regulatory changes and innovations in energy efficiency.

Adapun untuk risiko transisi, dilakukan kajian terhadap kemunginan penerapan pajak karbon yang dapat mempengaruhi kinerja debitur dengan adanya penambahan biaya atas pajak karbon yang harus dibayarkan. Risiko-risiko tersebut merupakan identifikasi risiko utama untuk infrastruktur jalan sehingga PT SMI dapat menerapkan langkah mitigasi yang tepat untuk mengatasi risiko tersebut. PT SMI is currently developing the Climate Risk Stress Test (CRST) framework, which serves as the foundation for assessing climate risks in accordance with the complexity of the company's business risks, particularly credit risk, which is PT SMI's primary risk exposure. The study being developed includes physical risk analysis, considering flood risk transmission, as well as transition risk analysis, taking into account the impact of rising carbon costs.

The preliminary CRST assessment has been conducted on road infrastructure, which represents one of PT SMI's largest financing portfolios. This assessment has identified risks aligned with the CRMS framework issued by the OJK. For flood risk, the primary concerns analyzed include potential productivity losses due to road inaccessibility and increased road repair costs resulting from flood-related physical damage. Regarding transition risk, the study examines the potential implementation of carbon taxes, which could impact debtor performance due to additional costs incurred from carbon tax obligations. These risks have been identified as key risks for road infrastructure, allowing PT SMI to implement appropriate mitigation measures to address them. Moving forward, this assessment will be expanded to other key infrastructure sectors, beyond road infrastructure, while considering sector-specific characteristics for a more tailored risk analysis. [GRI 201-2]

In addition to developing the Climate Risk Stress Test (CRST), in 2024, PT SMI collaborated with an independent consultant to conduct a gap analysis on disclosure and implementation in relation to the requirements of the International Financial Reporting Standards Standard 2 (IFRS S2) Climate-Related Disclosures. Melalui Divisi Evaluasi Lingkungan Sosial dan Teknik (DELST), Perseroan juga melakukan analisis risiko fisik perubahan iklim untuk setiap proyek yang akan di biayai. Analisis ini menjadi bagian dari Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD). Jika masih terdapat kesenjangan dalam mitigasi risiko fisik perubahan iklim yang dilakukan oleh calon debitur, Perseroan memberikan rekomendasi langkah-langkah mitigasi yang kemudian menjadi bagian dari syarat dalam perjanjian pembiayaan.

# KONTRIBUSI MAKSIMAL UNTUK KELESTARIAN LINGKUNGAN MAXIMUM CONTRIBUTION TO ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY

PT SMI sebagai Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN) yang bergerak di bidang pembiayaan infrastruktur, memiliki peran strategis dalam mendukung pembangunan yang berkelanjutan di Indonesia. PT SMI berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi terhadap pelestarian lingkungan dengan mengelola risiko terkait aspek lingkungan pada setiap pilar bisnis Perseroan.

Kontribusi Perseroan antara lain direalisasikan melalui berbagai pembiayaan proyek-proyek infrastruktur hijau atau pembiayaan berkelanjutan seperti pengelolaan air bersih, energi terbarukan, dan transportasi berkelanjutan.

Dalam penyaluran dana untuk pembiayaan berkelanjutan, PT SMI telah bekerja sama dengan berbagai lembaga internasional seperti Green Climate Fund (GCF), Agence Française de Développement (AFD), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit GmbH (GIZ), dan Bank Dunia. Melalui pembiayaan berkelanjutan, Perseroan juga telah turut membantu pengurangan emisi karbon dan mendorong transisi menuju ekonomi rendah karbon. Pendekatan ini sejalan dengan komitmen global untuk mencapai target Net Zero Emission serta mendukung pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB).

Selain itu, Perseroan juga memainkan peran penting dalam mendorong penerapan prinsip-prinsip keberlanjutan melalui proyek-proyek infrastruktur yang dibiayai. Dengan memastikan bahwa setiap proyek infrastruktur memperhatikan dampak lingkungan dan sosial. Perseroan tidak hanya membantu melindungi sumber daya alam, tetapi juga meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat. Pendekatan ini mencerminkan tanggung jawab perusahaan untuk menciptakan dampak positif secara tidak langsung terhadap lingkungan, sekaligus mempertegaskomitmen Perseroan dalam mendukung pembangunan infrastruktur yang tangguh dan berkelanjutan.

# Pendekatan Kelestarian Lingkungan [GRI 3-3] [GRI FS1]

Komitmen PT SMI terhadap kelestarian lingkungan melalui pembiayaan di bidang infrastruktur merupakan kepatuhan terhadap berbagai regulasi di bidang lingkungan baik undang-undang, peraturan pemerintah, peraturan menteri, peraturan daerah beserta turunannya. Selaras dengan itu, dalam menjalankan aktivitas bisnis, Perseroan senantiasa melakukan pengawasan atas kepatuhan aturan lingkungan bersama pemilik dan pelaksana proyek.

PT SMI, as a State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) engaged in infrastructure financing, plays a strategic role in supporting sustainable development in Indonesia. PT SMI is committed to contributing to environmental conservation by managing risks related to environmental aspects across all pillars of its business.

The Company's contributions are realized through various green infrastructure financing projects or sustainable financing, such as clean water management, renewable energy, and sustainable transportation.

In channeling funds for sustainable financing, PT SMI collaborated with various international institutions such as the Green Climate Fund (GCF), Agence Française de Développement (AFD), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit GmbH (GIZ), and the World Bank. Through sustainable financing, the Company also helped reduce carbon emissions and encourages the transition towards a low-carbon economy. This approach aligns with the global commitment to achieving Net Zero Emissions and supports the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Moreover, the Company performs a crucial role in promoting the implementation of sustainable principles through the infrastructure projects that are financed. By ensuring that each infrastructure project considers environmental and social impacts, the Company not only supports to protect natural resources but also improves the quality of life for communities. This approach reflects the Company's responsibility to create a positive indirect impact on the environment while reaffirming its commitment to supporting resilient and sustainable infrastructure development.

# Environmental Sustainability Approach [GRI 3-3] [GRI FS1]

PT SMI's commitment to environmental sustainability through infrastructure financing adheres to various environmental regulations, including laws, government regulations, ministerial regulations, regional regulations, and their derivatives. In line with this, the Company consistently monitors compliance with environmental regulations in collaboration with project owners and implementers.

Secara spesifik, tuntutan perlunya lembaga pembiayaan memberikan perhatian terhadap kelestarian lingkungan diatur dalam Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Nomor 32 Tahun 2009 tentang Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup, sebagaimana diubah dengan Undang-Undang No.11 Tahun 2020 tentang Cipta Kerja. Dalam Pasal 43, ayat (3), huruf c, undang-undang lingkungan terdapat klausul, "Pengembangan sistem lembaga keuangan dan pasar modal yang ramah lingkungan hidup." Menurut penjelasan undang-undang ini, yang dimaksud dengan "sistem lembaga keuangan ramah lingkungan hidup" adalah sistem lembaga keuangan yang menerapkan persyaratan perlindungan dan pengelolaan lingkungan hidup dalam kebijakan pembiayaan dan praktik sistem lembaga keuangan bank dan lembaga keuangan non-bank.

Regulasi terbaru tentang kewajiban lembaga pembiayaan memperhatikan masalah lingkungan diatur dalam Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No.51/POJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten dan Perusahaan Publik atau POJK Keuangan Berkelanjutan. Peraturan ini mendefinisikan keuangan berkelanjutan sebagai dukungan menyeluruh dari industri jasa keuangan untuk pertumbuhan berkelanjutan yang dihasilkan dari keselarasan antara kepentingan ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan hidup. Merujuk peraturan ini, PT SMI sebagai lembaga pembiayaan infrastruktur dikenai kewajiban untuk menerapkan keuangan berkelanjutan per 1 Januari 2020.

Dalam implementasi di lapangan, komitmen Perseroan terhadap kelestarian lingkungan dilakukan melalui berbagai inisiatif, kebijakan, maupun strategi bisnis. Inisiatif strategis pelestarian lingkungan PT SMI diwujudkan dalam 5 (lima) program utama yaitu:

1. Mitigasi dampak lingkungan dan sosial dari kegiatan usaha.
2. Program pembiayaan berkelanjutan.
3. Operasional kantor ramah lingkungan.
4. Optimasi manfaat lingkungan dari kegiatan usaha perseroan.
5. Penyediaan mekanisme pengaduan masalah lingkungan.

Lebih lanjut, inisiatif-inisiatif strategis kelestarian lingkungan hidup dilakukan Perseroan dengan menerapkan sistem prosedur operasional yang bertujuan untuk:

1. Mencegah pencemaran lingkungan, mencegah kerusakan aset demi memastikan kesinambungan bisnis;
2. Menunjukkan partisipasi dalam upaya konservasi energi, konservasi air, dan reduksi emisi gas rumah kaca;
3. Pengurangan dan pemanfaatan limbah B3 dan non-B3 serta perlindungan keanekaragaman hayati; dan
4. Meningkatnya efisiensi operasional sebagai hasil positif dari penerapan program green office.

Specifically, the requirement for financial institutions to pay attention to environmental sustainability is regulated under Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 32 of 2009 concerning Environmental Protection and Management, as amended by Law No. 11 of 2020 concerning Job Creation. Article 43, paragraph (3), letter (c) of the environmental law states the clause: "Development of environmentally friendly financial institutions and capital market systems." According to the law's explanation, an "environmentally friendly financial institution system" refers to financial institution system that implements environmental protection and management requirements in their financing policies and practices, both in bank and non-bank financial institutions.

The latest regulation on the obligation of financial institutions to consider environmental issues is stipulated in the Regulation of the Financial Services Authority No. 51/POJK.03/2017 concerning the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Service Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies, or POJK Sustainable Finance. This regulation defines sustainable finance as the comprehensive support from the financial services industry for sustainable growth that results from aligning economic, social, and environmental interests. Referring to this regulation, PT SMI, as an infrastructure financing institution, is required to implement sustainable finance as of January 1, 2020.

In practical implementation, the Company's commitment to environmental sustainability is conducted through various initiatives, policies, and business strategies. PT SMI's strategic environmental sustainability initiatives are embodied in 5 (five) main programs:

1. Mitigation of environmental and social impacts from business activities.
2. Sustainable financing programs.
3. Environmentally friendly office operations.
4. Optimization of environmental benefits from the Company's business activities.
5. Provision of mechanisms for environmental issue complaints.

Furthermore, the Company's strategic environmental sustainability initiatives are implemented by applying operational procedures aimed at:

1. Preventing environmental pollution and asset damage to ensure business continuity;
2. Demonstrating participation in energy conservation, water conservation, and greenhouse gas emission reduction efforts;
3. Reducing and utilizing B3 and non-B3 waste, as well as protecting biodiversity; and
4. Increasing operational efficiency as a positive result of implementing the green office program.

## Implikasi Financial Serta Risiko dan Peluang Lain Akibat dari Perubahan Iklim [GRI 3-3, 201-2] [OJK E.5]

Perubahan iklim merupakan tantangan tersendiri bagi pembangunan infrastruktur yang dibiayai PT SMI, terkhusus bagi debitur. Peningkatan frekuensi dan intensitas bencana alam seperti banjir, tanah longsor, dan badai tropis dapat merusak infrastruktur fisik, seperti jalan, jembatan, atau fasilitas energi, sehingga memperpendek masa pakai dan meningkatkan biaya pemeliharaan. Selain itu, kenaikan suhu global dan perubahan pola curah hujan juga dapat memengaruhi efisiensi operasional infrastruktur, misalnya dalam sektor energi dan pengelolaan air. Dalam hal ini, infrastruktur yang tidak dirancang untuk menghadapi dampak perubahan iklim berisiko kehilangan fungsionalitas lebih cepat, menghambat pertumbuhan ekonomi, dan menurunkan kualitas hidup masyarakat.

Untuk menghadapi tantangan tersebut, Perseroan berupaya untuk memastikan bahwa proyek-proyek yang dibiayai telah mengintegrasikan prinsip adaptasi terhadap perubahan iklim sejak tahap perencanaan. Adaptasi tersebut antara lain dilakukan melalui penerapan desain infrastruktur yang tangguh, seperti penguatan struktur bangunan, peninggian jalan di area rawan banjir, dan sistem drainase yang lebih efisien. Seiring dengan itu, Perseroan juga mendorong penerapan teknologi terkini yang dapat memantau dan memitigasi risiko perubahan iklim terhadap infrastruktur. Dengan langkah-langkah ini, selain menjaga keberlanjutan investasi, Perseroan juga turut mendukung ketahanan Indonesia terhadap dampak perubahan iklim melalui proyek pembangunan infrastruktur yang dibiayai.

To reinforce the implementation of these strategic initiatives, the Company has established policies related to occupational health and safety (OHS) and environmental protection, taking into account social aspects for communities through internal regulations, including:

2. Regulation of the Board of Directors No. PD-014/SMI/1123 dated November 9, 2023, concerning Procedures for Grievance Management of Affected Communities and Observer Groups (Revision - 1);
3. Regulation of the Board of Directors No. PD-022/SMI/0622 dated June 20, 2022, concerning Procedures for Gender Equality and Social Inclusion Mainstreaming; and

## Financial Implications, Risks, and Opportunities Arising from Climate Change [GRI 3-3, 201-2] [OJK E.5]

Climate change poses a significant challenge to the infrastructure development projects financed by PT SMI, particularly for debtors. The increasing frequency and intensity of natural disasters, such as floods, landslides, and tropical storms, can damage physical infrastructure, including roads, bridges, and energy facilities, thereby reducing their lifespan and increasing maintenance costs. Additionally, rising global temperatures and changes in rainfall patterns can impact the operational efficiency of infrastructure, particularly in the energy and water management sectors. In this context, infrastructure that is not designed to face the effects of climate change risks losing its functionality more rapidly, hindering economic growth, and lowering the quality of life for communities.

To address these challenges, the Company strive to ensure have integrated climate change adaptation principles into their projects from the planning stage. This adaptation is performed through the implementation of resilient infrastructure designs, such as strengthening building structures, elevating roads in flood-prone areas, and improving drainage systems. Alongside these measures, the Company also encourages the adoption of the latest technologies that can monitor and mitigate climate change risks to infrastructure. With these steps, in addition to maintaining the sustainability of investments, the Company also supports Indonesia's resilience to the impacts of climate change through the infrastructure development projects it finances.

Di PT SMI, kajian dan analisis terkait dampak perubahan iklim terhadap proyek infrastruktur yang akan dibiayai menjadi tanggung jawab Divisi Evaluasi Lingkungan Sosial dan Teknik, terutama physical risk seperti banjir, longsor dan lain-lain yang dapat menghambat operasional proyek. Kajian ini penting untuk dilakukan mengingat perubahan iklim dapat memengaruhi kemampuan debitur dalam memenuhi kewajiban membayar pinjaman kepada Perseroan.

Selain risiko fisik terhadap pembangunan infrastruktur, tantangan lain terkait perubahan iklim adalah terjadinya perubahan regulasi sebagai antisipasi terhadap fenomena global tersebut. Perubahan di bidang energi misalnya, pemerintah merilis kebijakan transisi energi bersih menuju nett zero emission tahun 2060 atau lebih cepat. Untuk mewujudkan kebijakan tersebut beberapa program sudah diluncurkan seperti phasing down pembangkit listrik tenaga uap (PLTU), emission trading mechanism, green taxonomy, dan sebagainya.

Bagi Perseroan, tantangan tersebut merupakan peluang untuk menyediakan pembiayaan pembangunan infrastruktur yang sejalan dengan kebijakan rendah karbon antara lain pembiayaan untuk menyediakan energi baru dan terbarukan. Di sisi lain, PT SMI akan mengurangi secara bertahap porsi pembiayaan proyek pembangkit listrik tenaga batu bara. Merujuk pada Rencana Aksi Keuangan Keberlanjutan Lima Tahun (2019-2024), PT SMI menetapkan target pengurangan/pembatasan jumlah pembiayaan/outstanding proyek pembangkit listrik tenaga batu bara maksimum 5%, peningkatan jumlah pembiayaan/outstanding terkait mitigasi perubahan iklim sampai mencapai minimal 10%, dan meningkatkan portofolio pembiayaan energi terbarukan dengan outstanding hingga Rp 3 trilion pada akhir tahun 2024.

## Perlindungan Lingkungan

Dalam menjalankan mandatnya sebagai katalis percepatan pembangunan nasional, PT SMI tidak hanya berfokus pada pembangunan infrastruktur, tetapi juga berupaya untuk dapat menciptakan multiplier effect yang dapat dirasakan para pemangku kepentingan dari seluruh proyek yang dibiayai. Untuk itu, dalam memberikan pembiayaan, Perseroan mendorong debitur dan pemangku kepentingan yang lain untuk mengerjakan proyek infrastruktur berwawasan lingkungan sehingga memberikan manfaat positif bagi aspek sosial, lingkungan, dan ekonomi.

Seiring dengan itu, Perseroan senantiasa menyelaraskan seluruh kegiatannya dengan SDGs sehingga aktivitas bisnis yang dilakukan dapat memberikan manfaat yang lebih besar. Dalam hal ini, Perseroan telah melakukan identifikasi beberapa program yang dapat dijalankan bersama para pemangku kepentingan sebagai realiasi atas komitmen terhadap perlindungan dan partisipasi aktif dalam memperbaiki kualitas lingkungan di antaranya melalui:

At PT SMI, studies and analyses related to the impact of climate change on infrastructure projects to be financed are the responsibility of the Environmental, Social, and Technical Evaluation Division, particularly in assessing physical risks such as flooding, landslides, and other hazards that may disrupt project operations. Conducting these assessments is crucial, as climate change can affect a debtor's ability to meet their loan repayment obligations to the Company.

In addition to the physical risks to infrastructure development, another challenge posed by climate change is regulatory changes implemented as a response to this global phenomenon. In the energy sector, for instance, the government has introduced a clean energy transition policy aimed at achieving net zero emissions by 2060 or earlier. Several programs have been launched to realize this policy, including the phasing down of coal-fired power plants (PLTU), emission trading mechanisms, green taxonomy, and others.

For the Company, these challenges present opportunities to provide infrastructure financing aligned with low-carbon policies, including financing for new and renewable energy projects. Conversely, PT SMI will gradually reduce the share of financing for coal-fired power plant projects. Referring to the Five-Year Sustainable Finance Action Plan (2019-2024), PT SMI has set a target to reduce/limit outstanding coal-fired power plant project financing to a maximum of 5%, increase outstanding climate change mitigation financing by until it reaches at least 10%, and expand the renewable energy financing portfolio to IDR3 trillion by the end of 2024.

Therefore, in providing financing, the Company encourages debtors and other stakeholders to undertake environmentally sound infrastructure projects that provide positive benefits for social, environmental, and economic aspects.

Along with that, the Company consistently aligns all of its activities with the SDGs to maximize the benefits of its business operations. PT SMI has identified several programs to be implemented in collaboration with stakeholders as a realization of the commitment to protection and active participation in improving environmental quality, including through:

Furthermore, the division performs role in offering guidance and enhancing debtors' comprehension of ESS principles and commitments.

PT SMI's ESS standards consist of ten references as follows:
- ESS 1: Assessment and Management of Environmental and Social Risks and Impacts
- ESS 2: Labor & Working Conditions
- ESS 3: Pollution Prevention and Abatement
- ESS 4: Safety, Health & Security
- ESS 5: Land Acquisition & Involuntary Resettlement
- ESS 6: Biodiversity Conservation & Natural Resources Management
- ESS 7: Indigenous Peoples
- ESS 8: Cultural Heritage
- ESS 9: Energy Conservation & Environmentally-friendly Energy
- ESS 10: Consultation & Grievance Redress Mechanism

In its implementation, the Company conducts environmental and social risk evaluations based on the Environmental and Social Safeguards Procedure. This procedure serves as a guideline for conducting assessments in every financing activity undertaken by PT SMI through Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD). The assessment is carried out to identify existing gaps and formulate follow-up actions in the form of a Corrective Action Plan (CAP).

Alur Penerapan Standar ESS Pada Proyek yang dibiayai PT SMI [FS2]

ESS Implementation Flow in PT SMI-Financed Projects [FS2]

Setiap proyek yang diusulkan untuk mendapatkan pembiayaan PT SMI akan mendapatkan screening awal mengenai seberapa besar potensi risiko atas dampak yang mungkin terjadi terhadap lingkungan risiko tersebut dilihat dari 10 standar ESS yang dimiliki oleh PT SMI.

Each project applying for PT SMI financing undergoes an initial screening to assess potential environmental risks based on the 10 ESS standards.

Tim DELST akan melakukan kajian secara komprehensif mulai dari desktop review hingga kajian lapangan dan penggunaan perangkat lunak pendukung (GIS, Integrated Biodiversity Assessment Tool/IBAT, dan referensi online) yang hasilnya dituangkan dalam laporan ESDD.

The DELST team conducts a comprehensive review, starting with a desktop review, followed by field assessments and the use of supporting software tools (GIS, IBAT, and online references). The findings are compiled into an Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD) report.

Dalam ESDD tersebut disebutkan pula risiko yang mungkin muncul serta langkah-langkah tindakan perbaikan (Corrective Action Plan/CAP) yang direkomendasikan untuk mitigasi potensi risiko lingkungan dan sosial. CAP tersebut dikomunikasikan kepada calon debitur untuk memastikan kapasitas calon debitur memenuhi CAP sesuai dengan tenggat waktu yang diberikan.

In the ESDD process, potential risks are identified along with recommended improvement measures (Corrective Action Plan/CAP) to mitigate environmental and social risks. The CAP is conveyed to prospective debtors to ensure that they have the capacity to implement the required corrective actions within the specified timeframe.

Hasil ESDD akan disampaikan kepada pihak internal PT SMI (Manajemen sebagai pengambil keputusan) untuk menjadi pertimbangan.

Tahapan ini merupakan tahapan yang sangat penting karena terdapat keputusan PT SMI untuk membiayai proyek tersebut atas tidak. CAP menjadi persyaratan dalam Perjanjian Pembiayaan yang harus dijalankan oleh debitur.

Results of the ESDD are submitted to PT SMI's internal stakeholders, including management, as part of the decision-making process. This stage is critical, as it determines whether PT SMI will proceed with financing the project. The Corrective Action Plan (CAP) is incorporated as a mandatory requirement in the Financing Agreement, which debtors must implement.

Selanjutnya, DELST melakukan pemantauan atas pemenuhan CAP dan pelaporan rutin sesuai perjanjian, yang mencakup:[FS3]

1. Memantau pemenuhan CAP dan melaporkannya kepada divisi bisnis terkait tiap bulan;
2. Memantau dan melaporkan tingkat pemenuhan CAP sebagai salah satu komponen dalam Risk Appetite Statement Perseroan;
3. Melakukan monitoring site visit;
4. Menyusun laporan Environmental and Social Monitoring Report (ESMR) untuk proyek.

Apabila terdapat CAP yang belum dilaksanakan sesuai dengan tenggat waktu, maka Perseroan akan berkomunikasi dengan debitur untuk mendiskusikan rencana tindakan lanjut sesuai dengan mekanisme komunikasi dan eskalasi yang telah diatur dalam Perjanjian Pembiayaan. Selain itu, DELST juga dapat memberikan panduan dan/atau bantuan kepada debitur dalam upayanya memenuhi CAP yang dipersyaratkan.

Tak hanya evaluasi per proyek, Perseroan juga melakukan evaluasi tiap tahun atas pelaksanaan berbagai upaya perlindungan lingkungan dan sosial yang dilakukan Perseroan. Salah satunya melalui penyusunan Annual Environmental and Social Safeguard Performance Report yang mulai dibuat sejak 2019. Selain berisi kinerja selama satu tahun, laporan juga berisi tindakan perbaikan yang dapat dijalankan oleh Perseroan.

Following this, the Environmental, Social, and Technical Evaluation Division (DELST) is responsible for monitoring compliance with the CAP and ensuring regular reporting as stipulated in the agreement. This includes: [FS3]

1. Monitoring CAP implementation and reporting updates to the relevant business division on a monthly basis;
2. Assessing and reporting the level of CAP compliance as a component of the Company's Risk Appetite Statement;
3. Conducting on-site monitoring visits;
4. Preparing the Environmental and Social Monitoring Report (ESMR) for the project.

If any CAP requirements are not met within the agreed timeframe, PT SMI will engage with the debtor to discuss further action, in accordance with the communication and escalation mechanisms set out in the Financing Agreement. Additionally, DELST may provide guidance and/or assistance to debtors in fulfilling the CAP requirements.

Beyond project-specific evaluations, PT SMI also conducts an annual review of its environmental and social safeguards implementation. Since 2019, this has been documented in the Annual Environmental and Social Performance Report, which not only presents the Company's yearly performance but also outlines corrective actions that can be undertaken for continuous improvement.

Sejalan dengan pemantauan kinerja debitur, Perseroan juga membuka kanal bagi masyarakat maupun pemangku kepentingan lain yang terdampak proyek pembangunan infrastruktur yang dibiayai PT SMI melalui para debitur. Melalui kanal Prosedur Pengelolaan Keluhan Masyarakat Terdampak dan Kelompok Pemertahit, semua masukan dan/atau keluhan terkait dengan aspek lingkungan dan sosial akan dicatat, diverifikasi dan selanjutnya Perseroan akan menyusun action plan untuk menangani dan mencari solusi terbaik. Untuk mengetahui kemajuan atas pelaksanaan action plan, Perseroan melakukan pemantauan secara berkala.[2-25]

Informasi lebih lanjut terkait prosedur dan kerangka kerja ESS PT SMI dapat dilihat pada situs web Perseroan denganalamat https://www.ptsmi.co.id/perlindungan-lingkungan-sosial.

In line with debtor performance monitoring, the Company also provides a channel for communities and other stakeholders affected by infrastructure projects financed by PT SMI through its debtors. Through the Procedure for Managing Complaints from Affected Communities and Advocacy Groups, all feedback and/or complaints related to environmental and social aspects are recorded, verified, and addressed by developing an action plan to resolve issues and find the best solutions. To track progress on the implementation of the action plan, PT SMI conducts regular monitoring to ensure that concerns are properly managed and addressed. [2-25]

For further details on PT SMI's ESS framework and procedures, please visit the Company's website at https:// www.ptsmi.co.id/environmental-social-safeguards.

# Penilaian Kinerja Debitur untuk Pelaksanaan ESS

Sebagai bagian dari bentuk pemantauan, DELST menjalankan inisiatif untuk melakukan penilaian terhadap pemenuhan Corrective Action Plan / CAP yang meliputi aspek kepatuhan dan kualitas. Selain merupakan salah satu bentuk pemantauan, penilaian juga bertujuan untuk:

- Membantu meningkatkan persentase dari pemenuhan Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) PT SMI;
- Menghasilkan kualitas pemantauan pemenuhan CAP yang lebih baik;
- Meningkatkan kualitas pelaksanaan perlindungan lingkungan dan sosial dari para debitur;
- Menciptakan hubungan yang lebih baik dengan para debitur; dan
- Menunjukkan komitmen penerapan pelaksanaan perlindungan lingkungan dan sosial baik untuk shareholder, stakeholder dan lembaga multilateral.

## Debtor Performance Assessment for ESS Implementation

As part of its monitoring efforts, the Environmental, Social, and Technical Evaluation Division (DELST) has initiated an assessment of Corrective Action Plan (CAP) compliance, covering both compliance and quality aspects. In addition to monitoring, the assessment aims to:

- Improve the percentage of PT SMI's Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) compliance;
- Enhance the quality of CAP monitoring and compliance assessment;
- Improve the quality of environmental and social safeguards implementation by debtors;
- Foster stronger relationships with debtors; and
- Demonstrate PT SMI's commitment to environmental and social protection to shareholders, stakeholders, and multilateral institutions.

Proses pelaksanaan penilaian kinerja debitur dilakukan dengan tahapan sebagai berikut:

The debtor performance assessment process follows these stages:

1. **Penilaian Tingkat Kepatuhan dan Tingkat Kinerja (Aspek Ketepatan Waktu)**

Penilaian tingkat kepatuhan dilakukan dengan melihat jumlah pemenuhan CAP (bobot 20%) dan laporan rutin (bobot 10%). Sementara itu, penilaian tingkat kinerja (untuk aspek ketepatan waktu) dilakukan dengan menilai ketepatan waktu dari pemenuhan CAP di mana bobotnya adalah sebesar 20%. Proses penilaian dilakukan dengan tahapan sebagai berikut:

a. Seluruh staf DELST melakukan update pemenuhan CAP seluruh debitur yang dilakukan setiap akhir bulan melalui sistem database monitoring DELST (kegiatan ini telah dilakukan secara rutin sejak Maret 2020);
b. PIC Penilaian melakukan penarikan data dan menilai tingkat kepatuhan dan ketepatan waktu untuk seluruh debitur dengan cut off data per 31 Juli 2024; dan
c. PIC Penilaian melakukan shortlist debitur terbaik.

2. **Penilaian atas Kualitas Pembiayaan**

Penilaian atas kualitas pembiayaan dilakukan dengan melihat aspek kelancaran pembayaran, ada tidaknya restrukturisasi pinjaman, kinerja keuangan secara keseluruhan serta kualitas koordinasi yang dilakukan selama pinjaman. Penilaian dilakukan oleh setiap RM yang menjadi PIC debitur dengan mengisi kuesioner melalui google form untuk kemudian dianalisis oleh PIC penilaian. PIC penilaian juga melakukan skrining berdasarkan data dari DPOP dan DPPIK. Persentasi pembobotan sebesar 10%.

3. **Penilaian atas Publikasi Negatif terkait Proyek/Debitur**

Penilaian aspek publikasi negatif terkait proyek/debitur dilakukan melalui: i) News monitoring yang telah tersedia; ii) Pencarian berita melalui media monitoring mandiri; iii) Informasi langsung melalui surat, surel, verbal dan lainnya; iv) Dokumen lainnya seperti laporan tahunan perlindungan lingkungan dan sosial. Persentase pembobotan terhadap penilaian ini yaitu sebesar 10%.

4. **Penilaian Kualitas CAP Melalui Diskusi Panel**

Penilaian terhadap kualitas dari pemenuhan CAP (bobot 30%) membutuhkan expert judgement. Penilaian ini membutuhkan informasi komprehensif yang dapat disampaikan oleh setiap PIC debitur (staf DELST) dan pandangan/pendapat dari expert lainnya (dalam hal ini internal DELST). Atas dasar tersebut maka diadakan Diskusi Panel pada tanggal 27 Agustus 2024.

Dari proses penilaian yang dilakukan tersebut telah terpilih tujuh debitur yang dinilai menjalankan pemenuhan CAP dengan baik.

1. **Compliance and Performance Level Assessment (Timeliness Aspect)**

Compliance assessment is based on the number of CAP fulfillments (20% weight) and regular reporting compliance (10% weight). Meanwhile, performance assessment (timeliness aspect) evaluates the timeliness of CAP implementation, weighted at 20%. The assessment process consists of:

a. DELST staff updating CAP fulfillment data for all debtors at the end of each month through the DELST database monitoring system (this routine has been conducted since March 2020).
b. The assessment PIC extracting data and evaluating compliance and timeliness for all debtors, using July 31, 2024, as the data cut-off date.
c. The assessment PIC shortlisting the best-performing debtors.

2. **Assessment on Financing Quality**

Financing quality is assessed based on payment performance, loan restructuring status, overall financial performance, and coordination quality throughout the loan period. The assessment is conducted by each Relationship Manager (RM), who serves as the PIC for each debtor, by filling out a questionnaire via Google Forms, which is then analyzed by the assessment PIC. The assessment PIC also screens data from DPOP and DPPIK, with a weighting of 10%.

3. **Assessment on Negative Publicity Related to Projects/Debtors**

The assessment of negative publicity related to projects or debtors is conducted through the following methods: i) News monitoring from available sources; ii) Independent media monitoring to search for relevant news; iii) Direct information received via letters, emails, verbal reports, or other channels; iv) Other documents, such as the Annual Environmental and Social Protection Report. The weighting percentage for this assessment is 10%.

4. **Assessment on CAP Quality Through Panel Discussion**

The quality of CAP implementation (30% weight) requires expert judgment. This assessment is based on comprehensive information provided by each PIC debtor (DELST staff) and expert opinions from internal DELST evaluators. To ensure objective evaluation, a Panel Discussion was held on August 27, 2024.

Following this assessment process, seven debtors were identified as having effectively fulfilled their CAP obligations.

Sejalan dengan penilaian tersebut, Perseroan juga menyadari bahwa Relationship Manager (RM) memiliki peranan yang amat penting dalam meningkatkan upaya pemenuhan CAP dan pelaksanaan pengelolaan serta pemantauan lingkungan dari Debitur/Proyek. Oleh karenanya, Perseroan juga memberikan apresiasi kepada para RM yang telah berkoordinasi dan bekerjasama dengan baik bersama Debitur dalam memenuhi persyaratan CAP lingkungan dan sosial selama periode tahun 2023 serta telah mendukung terlaksananya inisiatif penilaian kinerja debitur tahun 2023.

In line with the debtor performance assessment, the Company acknowledges the critical role of Relationship Managers (RM) in improving CAP compliance, environmental management, and monitoring efforts by debtors and projects. Therefore, PT SMI recognizes and appreciates RMs who have demonstrated strong coordination and collaboration with debtors in meeting environmental and social CAP requirements during 2023 and who have contributed to the successful implementation of the 2023 debtor performance assessment initiative.

Untuk Debitur dan RM di atas, Perseroan memberikan apresiasi dalam bentuk pelaksanaan workshop “Perlindungan Biodiversitas dan Elemen Desain dalam Pelaksanaan Proyek Pembangunan Infrastruktur Berkelanjutan di Indonesia”. Selain merupakan bentuk apresiasi kepada Debitur terpilih dan RM, kegiatan ini sekaligus sebagai upaya PT SMI untuk terus dapat meningkatkan pelaksanaan pengelolaan perlindungan lingkungan sosial di setiap proyek yang dibiayai serta sebagai ajang pembelajaran bersama yang baik antara para Debitur dan PT SMI.

As a form of appreciation, PT SMI organized a workshop titled: “Biodiversity Protection and Design Elements in Implementing Sustainable Infrastructure Projects in Indonesia.” This event not only serves as a token of recognition for selected debtors and RMs, but also aligns with PT SMI’s continuous efforts to enhance environmental and social protection management in every financed project. It also provides a valuable learning platform for both debtors and PT SMI to exchange knowledge and best practices.

In its implementation, financing is directed towards projects that actively contribute to climate change mitigation and address environmental challenges through environmental management, environmental quality improvement, reduction of global warming threats, and support for low-carbon development.

The Company prioritizes the New and Renewable Energy sector for sustainable financing. This choice is based on the factual condition that financing for green projects in this sector remains limited. As an illustration, as of

# Pembiayaan Proyek PLTS Terapung Tembesi

Perseroan memberikan fasilitas pembiayaan kepada PT Nusantara Tembesi Baru Energi (PT NTBE) senilai USD 23,3 juta. Fasilitas pembiayaan tersebut disalurkan untuk pembangunan proyek Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Surya (PLTS) Terapung Tembesi di Batam, dengan kapasitas 46 MWp. Proyek PLTS Tembesi termasuk ke dalam kategori Proyek Strategis Nasional dan merupakan Proyek Floating Solar terbesar kedua setelah PLTS Cirata.

Penandatangan perjanjian dilakukan di kantor PT SMI, pada tanggal 16 Desember 2024, oleh Direktur Pembiayaan dan Investasi PT SMI, Sylvi J. Gani, Direktur Utama PT NTBE, Mahzuri dan Direktur PT NTBE, Pria Fardio Syaiful Dinar.

PLTS Tembesi merupakan proyek Energi Baru Terbarukan terbesar di Kepulauan Riau (Kepri), yang akan mengakomodasi kebutuhan energi di wilayah tersebut. Dengan adanya PLTS ini, diharapkan dapat menarik investor asing untuk berinvestasi di Batam sehingga dapat turut memperkuat ekonomi lokal. PLTS Tembesi Batam saat ini sedang menjalani tahap konstruksi dengan target penyelesaian operasi komersial penuh pada kisaran kuartal kedua hingga kuartal ketiga tahun 2025.

The Company has provided a financing facility to PT Nusantara Tembesi Baru Energi (PT NTBE) amounting to USD23.3 million. This financing is allocated for the development of the Tembesi Floating Solar Power Plant (PLTS) in Batam, with a capacity of 46 MWp.

PLTS Tembesi project is classified as a National Strategic Project (PSN) and is the second-largest floating solar project in Indonesia after PLTS Cirata. The financing agreement was signed at PT SMI's office on December 16, 2024, by Sylvi J. # Geothermal Resources Risk Mitigation (GREM)

Eksplorasi panas bumi merupakan salah satu bentuk dukungan PT SMI terhadap pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan/TPB atau Sustainable Development Goals/SDGs ke-7 yaitu Energi Bersih dan Terjangkau. Kegiatan eksplorasi panas bumi mendapat fasilitas pembiayaan dari Geothermal Resource Risk Mitigation (GREM), fasilitas pembiayaan eksplorasi panas bumi yang dapat diakses oleh sektor swasta dan publik di Indonesia. Fasilitas pendanaan ini disetujui oleh Green Climate Fund (GCF) pada tahun 2018 dan tercatat sebagai proposal pendanaan pertama yang disetujui di Indonesia. Melalui pengelolaan oleh Perseroan, program ini dirancang untuk mengatasi risiko eksplorasi dan risiko politik yang terkait dengan tahapan eksplorasi panas bumi.

# Geothermal Resources Risk Mitigation (GREM)

Geothermal exploration is one of PT SMI's contributions towards achieving Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) No. 7, which focuses on Affordable and Clean Energy. Geothermal exploration activities receive financial support from the Geothermal Resource Risk Mitigation (GREM) facility, a financing program for geothermal exploration that is accessible to both the private and public sectors in Indonesia. This funding facility was approved by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) in 2018 and is recorded as the first funding proposal approved in Indonesia. Through its management by the Company, this program is designed to address exploration risks and political risks related to geothermal exploration phases.

Fitur khusus GREM adalah tersedianya fasilitas de-risking atau skema risk sharing di mana dalam hal terjadi kegagalan eksplorasi dan/atau risiko politik, pengembang tidak sepenuhnya menanggung risiko dan biaya eksplorasi. Kekhususan lain fasilitas ini adalah kemampuannya mengurangi pembayaran hingga 50% dari total biaya fasilitas untuk setiap proyek yang menghadapi risiko eksplorasi atau politik. Dengan demikian, GREM memberikan dukungan signifikan bagi pengembangan panas bumi di Indonesia, mengurangi beban finansial, dan risiko bagi para pengembang dalam sektor ini.

Pendanaan GREM berasal dari penerusan pinjaman multilateral yang dikelola Bank Dunia (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development/IBRD, Clean Technology Fund/CTF, Green Climate Fund/GCF) dan Pemerintah Indonesia dengan total sebesar USD197,5 juta. Pendanaan untuk komponen de-risking pengembang BUMN bersumber dari komitmen dana Pembiayaan Infrastruktur Sektor Panas Bumi/PISP sebesar USD150 juta, sedangkan untuk pengembang swasta bersumber dari reimbursable grant GCF dan CTF yang dikelola Bank Dunia sebesar total USD122,5 juta. Selain itu, terdapat juga dana hibah yang ditujukan untuk technical assistance, capacity building, dan bantuan terkait operasionalisasi GREM dengan komitmen maksimal yang direncanakan sebesar USD10 juta berasal dari CTF, GCF, Global Infrastructure Facility (GIF), dan ESMAP (Energy Sector Management Assistance Program) sesuai syarat dan ketentuan masing-masing.

Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan melakukan persiapan proyek untuk pengembang publik, pengembang swasta, pengembangan kapasitas, serta restrukturisasi GREM.

Terkait dengan persiapan proyek GREM Public Window, Perseroan telah menyelesaikan proses uji tuntas teknis untuk 2 (dua) lapangan publik serta mengirimkan commence to proceed untuk 1 (satu) wilayah kepada pengembang publik sehingga dapat menyampaikan proposal lengkap kepada PT SMI. Pengembang publik saat ini masih dalam tahap finalisasi dokumen proposal serta dokumen sosial lingkungan sesuai dengan standar Bank Dunia. Perseroan terus berperan aktif dalam mendukung persiapan dokumen sosial lingkungan dengan memberikan tanggapan serta reviu terhadap rancangan dokumen yang diberikan guna membantu pengembang publik untuk mempersiapkan dokumen sesuai dengan standar Bank Dunia.

Kemudian dalam persiapan proyek GREM Private Window, Perseroan mendapatkan pernyataan minat dari 2 (dua) pengembang swasta untuk wilayah Indonesia Timur. Perseroan berperan aktif dalam mempersiapkan ekosistem pendanaan eksplorasi dengan memberikan workshop mengenai proses serta standar GREM terhadap pengembang swasta yang menyatakan minat. Perseroan telah melaksanakan kunjungan lapangan terhadap lapangan tersebut guna mendapatkan pandangan yang komprehensif terkait dengan kondisi proyek. Selanjutnya, Perseroan juga tengah melaksanakan preliminary assessment terhadap area tersebut guna mengidentifikasi gap pada proyek

A unique feature of GREM is the availability of a de-risking facility or a risk-sharing scheme where, in the event of exploration failure and/or political risks, developers do not bear the full cost and risk of exploration. Another distinct feature of this facility is its ability to reduce payments by up to 50% of the total facility cost for any project facing exploration or political risks. Thus, GREM provides significant support for the development of geothermal energy in Indonesia, reducing the financial burden and risks for developers in this sector.

GREM funding is sourced from the on-lending of multilateral loans managed by the World Bank (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development/IBRD, Clean Technology Fund/CTF, Green Climate Fund/GCF) and the Government of Indonesia, with a total of USD197.5 million. Funding for the de-risking component for SOE developers comes from the commitment of the Geothermal Infrastructure Financing Facility (PISP) amounting to USD150 million, while funding for private developers comes from reimbursable grants from the GCF and CTF managed by the World Bank, totaling USD122.5 million. Additionally, there are grant funds intended for technical assistance, capacity building, and support for the operationalization of GREM, with a maximum planned commitment of USD10 million sourced from CTF, GCF, Global Infrastructure Facility (GIF), and ESMAP (Energy Sector Management Assistance Program), according to the terms and conditions of each.

To ensure comprehensive project assessment, the Company conducted field visits to the identified sites to gain a holistic understanding of project conditions. ## SOE Drilling

Skema SOE Drilling adalah dukungan berupa pemberian pinjaman yang juga memiliki komponen risk sharing untuk mendukung studi kelayakan proyek eksplorasi panas bumi yang ditujukan kepada Debitur Publik. Skema ini sepenuhnya bersumber dari dana PISP, tanpa kerja sama dengan institusi keuangan internasional. Komponen risk sharing dalam skema ini memungkinkan pengembang untuk tidak sepenuhnya menanggung risiko dan biaya eksplorasi dalam hal terjadi kegagalan eksplorasi dan/atau risiko politik. Kekhususan lain fasilitas ini adalah kemampuannya untuk mengurangi pembayaran hingga 50% dari total biaya fasilitas bagi setiap proyek yang menghadapi risiko eksplorasi atau politik.

Saat ini, pipeline skema SOE Drilling adalah proyek eksplorasi Candradimuka, di area WKP Dieng, PT Geo Dipa Energi (PT GDE). Terdapat potensi pipeline lainnya yaitu Songa Wayaua dan Atadei yang dikelola oleh PT PLN (Persero).

## SOE Drilling

The SOE Drilling Scheme is a loan support that also has a risk sharing component to support the feasibility study of geothermal exploration projects aimed at Public Debtors. The scheme is fully sourced from PISP funds, with no cooperation with international financial institutions. The risk sharing component in this scheme allows developers not to fully bear the risks and costs of exploration in the event of exploration failure and/or political risk. Another specificity of the facility is its ability to reduce payments by up to 50% of the total facility cost for any project that faces exploration or political risks.

Currently, the SOE Drilling scheme pipeline is the Candradimuka exploration project, in the WKP Dieng area, PT Geo Dipa Energi (PT GDE). Other potential pipelines include Songa Wayaua and Atadei managed by PT PLN (Persero).

## Geothermal Upstream Development Program (GEUDP)

PT SMI secara berkelanjutan melakukan optimalisasi potensi sumber daya panas bumi sesuai dengan rencana pemerintah dalam rangka mendorong pengembangan Energi Baru dan Terbarukan (EBT). Geothermal Upstream Development Program (GEUDP) adalah program kolaborasi antara Pemerintah dan Bank Dunia dengan upaya melakukan penambahan data pada situs panas bumi sebelum situs tersebut ditawarkan kepada pengembang panas bumi oleh Ditjen Energi Baru, Terbarukan, dan Konservasi Energi (EBTKE), Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral melalui skema Pengeboran Pemerintah (Government Drilling).

PT SMI berperan sebagai pengelola dana (fund manager) dari beberapa sumber dana Bank Dunia dan PT Geo Dipa Energi (GDE) berperan sebagai badan pelaksana (implementing agency). Dana yang diberikan oleh Bank Dunia bersifat hibah (grant) dan memerlukan cofinancing dari dana pemerintah melalui dana Pembiayaan Infrastruktur Sektor Panas Bumi (PISP). Sumber dana GEUDP tersebut adalah Clean Technology Fund (CTF) sebesar USD49 juta, Dana PISP sebesar USD49 juta, dan Global Environmental Facility (GEF) sebesar USD6,25 juta.

## PISP Government Drilling

Sampai pada tahun 2024, pipeline proyek PISP Government Drilling ini masih 1 proyek, yaitu proyek eksplorasi Waesano. PT SMI dan PT GDE telah mendapat penugasan khusus untuk melaksanakan penugasan dukungan eksplorasi pada proyek Waesano berdasarkan Keputusan Menteri Keuangan ("KMK") berikut:

## Geothermal Upstream Development Program (GEUDP)

PT SMI continuously optimizes the potential of geothermal resources in line with the government's plan to promote the development of Renewable Energy (EBT). The Geothermal Upstream Development Program (GEUDP) is a collaborative initiative between the Government and the World Bank, aimed at enhancing data availability on geothermal sites before they are offered to geothermal developers. This program is facilitated by the Directorate General of New, Renewable Energy, and Energy Conservation (EBTKE) under the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources through the Government Drilling scheme.

PT SMI acts as a fund manager from several funding sources from the WB and PT GDE acts as an implementing agency. The funds provided by the World Bank are in the form of grants and require cofinancing from Government funds through Geothermal Sector Infrastructure Financing (PISP) fund. The sources of GEUDP funds are the Clean Technology Fund (CTF) amounting to USD49 million, PISP Fund amounting to USD49 million, and the Global Environmental Facility (GEF) amounting to USD6.25 million.

## PISP Government Drilling

Until 2024, the PISP Government Drilling project pipeline is still 1 project, namely the Waesano exploration project. PT SMI and PT GDE have received special assignments to carry out exploration support assignments on the Waesano project based on the following Decree of the Minister of Finance ("KMK"):

2. Decree of the Minister of Finance No. 9/KM.8/2024 for PT GDE, dated January 19, 2024

# Sertifikasi Greenship

Sebagai wujud komitmen atas penerapan konsep green office, Perseroan telah melakukan penilaian sertifikasi GREENSHIP Interior Space. GREENSHIP adalah salah satu program sertifikasi green building yang menjadi perangkat Tolok ukur untuk menilai perangkat suatu bangunan terhadap pencapaian konsep ramah lingkungan. Berkaitan dengan itu, Perseroan mengambil berbagai langkah di antaranya mengurangi pemakaian energi dan sumber daya untuk keberlanjutan manusia dan lingkungan, yaitu kampanye secara massif dan berkesinambungan, serta memformalkan upaya nyata yang telah dilakukan tersebut melalui program sertifikasi GREENSHIP.

Pada tahun 2018, PT SMI telah melakukan pre-assessment GREENSHIP melalui Jasa Konsultan Assessment GREENSHIP dan mendapatkan predikat level "Bronze". Selanjutnya pada April 2022, Perseroan mendaftarkan sertifikasi green office di mana proses sertifikasi tersebut berjalan pada bulan April 2022 sampai Februari 2023 dan sidang serta tinjauan assessor pada bulan Mei 2023. Selanjutnya, pada bulan Agustus 2023, PT SMI mendapatkan sertifikasi dengan level tertinggi yakni "Platinum" dari penilai Green Building Council Indonesia (GBCI), yang merupakan Emerging Member dari World Green Building Council (WGBC).

Seluruh pengelolaan kantor ramah lingkungan dilakukan di bawah tanggung jawab Divisi Umum dan Pengadaan. Divisi Umum dan Pengadaan juga akan memberikan laporan bulanan terkait efektivitas implementasi kebijakan penggunaan listrik, emisi, air, dan limbah ke Direksi untuk selanjutnya dilakukan evaluasi mengenai tindakan peningkatan yang dibutuhkan. # Greenship Certification

As a manifestation of PT SMI's commitment to the concept of a green office, the company has undergone certification assessment for GREENSHIP Interior Space. GREENSHIP is one of the green building certification programs serving as a benchmark to assess the rating of a building in achieving environmentally friendly concepts. As part of the Company's commitment to realizing an environmentally friendly office, PT SMI has taken concrete steps to reduce energy consumption and resources for human and environmental sustainability. This includes mass and sustained campaign efforts, as well as formalizing these efforts through the GREENSHIP certification program.

In 2018, PT SMI underwent a pre-assessment for GREENSHIP through a GREENSHIP Assessment Consultant and achieved a "Bronze" level rating. Subsequently, in April 2022, the Company applied for green office certification, with the certification process running from April 2022 to February 2023, including assessor hearings and reviews in May 2023. Then, in August 2023, PT SMI obtained the highest level of certification, "Platinum", from the assessor of the Green Building Council Indonesia (GBCI), an Emerging Member of the World Green Building Council (WGBC).

All management of environmentally friendly offices is conducted under the responsibility of the General and Procurement Division. This division also provides monthly reports on the effectiveness of implementing policies regarding electricity usage, emissions, water, and waste to the Board of Directors for further evaluation of necessary improvement actions. ## Penghematan Kertas

Penghematan kertas merupakan salah satu kebijakan terkait kantor ramah lingkungan yang dijalankan sejak tahun 2018. Perseroan menyadari bahwa program penghematan kertas secara tidak langsung berkontribusi dalam menjaga kelestarian alam, terutama kelangsungan hidup hutan karena kertas dibuat dengan bahan baku pohon. Program penghematan kertas sebagai bagian dari green action dilakukan melalui:

1. Melakukan digitalisasi pengelolaan dokumen melalui pengembangan aplikasi
2. Electronic Document Management System (E-DMS) baik untuk dokumen Korporasi maupun dokumen-dokumen pembiayaan.
3. Melakukan proses persetujuan secara digital (e-approval) melalui pengembangan aplikasi sistem maupun melalui Privyid.
4. Penggunaan otomasi printer dengan teknologi Management Print System (MPS), sehingga kertas yang dihasilkan dapat diatur oleh pengguna/karyawan.
5. Otomasi proses kerja dan layanan (proses kerjanya dijelaskan terkait yg sebelumnya manual menjadi digital).
6. Pengukuran pencapaian dan pelaporan dari penghematan kertas secara berkala.
7. Sosialisasi penerapan budaya paperless kepada seluruh Insan Perseroan.
8. Pembuatan kartu nama digital.

In 2024, PT SMI entered its third phase of EV procurement, purchasing 7 (seven) electric vehicles. Previously, the first phase of EV acquisition took place in May 2022, with the purchase of 2 (two) electric vehicles, followed by the second phase in May 2023, when another 2 (two) electric vehicles were added to the fleet. With the latest addition of 7 (seven), electric vehicles, PT SMI has successfully reduced fuel consumption by 23.8% as of December 31, 2024, an increase compared to the 11% fuel savings achieved in 2022-2023.

## Paper-Saving Initiatives

Paper-saving is one of the key green office policies implemented by PT SMI since 2018. The Company acknowledges that reducing paper usage indirectly supports environmental conservation, particularly by preserving forests, as paper production relies on tree-based raw materials. The paper-saving initiatives under PT SMI's green action strategy include:

1. Digitizing document management through the development of application
2. Electronic Document Management System (E-DMS) for both corporate and financing documents.
3. Conducting a digital approval process (e-approval) through the development of system applications and through Privyid.
4. Use of printer automation with Management Print System (MPS) technology, so that the paper produced can be managed by users/employees.
5. Automation of work processes and services (the work process is explained related to what was previously manual to digital).
6. Measurement of achievement and reporting of paper savings on a regular basis.
7. Socialization of the implementation of paperless culture to all Company personnel.
8. Creation of digital business cards.

# Pengelolaan Konsumsi Energi

Operasional PT SMI memerlukan dua sumber energi utama yaitu bahan bakar minyak (BBM) dan listrik yang dipasok oleh pihak ketiga. Listrik dimanfaatkan Perseroan untuk penerangan dan sumber energi sarana dan prasarana elektronik perkantoran. Sementara itu, BBM dimanfaatkan sebagai sumber energi kendaraan operasional, genset dan sebagainya.

Dalam memanfaatkan BBM dan listrik, Perseroan secara konsisten melakukan berbagai langkah efisiensi. Hal itu dilakukan karena Perseroan menyadari bahwa BBM sebagai sumber energi tak terbarukan berbasis fosil ketersediaannya terbatas. Sementara itu, sumber pembangkit utama listrik di Indonesia saat ini masih dominan menggunakan batu bara yang juga termasuk sumber energi tak terbarukan berbasis fosil yang pasokannya terus menipis. Efisiensi energi sekaligus merupakan langkah Perseroan untuk mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca. Oleh karenanya, Perseroan terus melakukan berbagai upaya untuk melakukan efisiensi energi, melakukan pencatatan dan pelaporan rutin (yang dilaksanakan oleh Divisi Umum dan Pengadaan) serta melakukan evaluasi secara berkala. [GRI 305-5] [OJK F.12] [GRI 3-3]

Sejak tahun 2022, Perseroan secara bertahap mengganti kendaraan operasional yang sebelumnya menggunaan BBM menjadi kendaraan listrik. Pada bulan Mei 2024, Perseroan melakukan pembelian 7 unit mobil operasional dengan sistem hibrida, yaitu sistem yang menggabungkan mesin bensin dengan motor listrik, menggantikan mobil operasional yang masih menggunakan BBM untuk meningkatkan efisiensi bahan bakar dan mengurangi emisi.

# Energy Consumption Management

PT SMI's operations rely on two primary energy sources: fuel (BBM) and electricity, both supplied by third parties. Electricity is utilized for lighting and powering office electronic equipment, while fuel is used for operational vehicles, generators, and other needs.

In utilizing fuel and electricity, the Company consistently implements various efficiency measures. This approach is taken because the Company recognizes that fuel, as a non-renewable fossil-based energy source, has limited availability. Meanwhile, Indonesia's primary electricity generation still predominantly relies on coal, which is also a non-renewable fossil-based energy source with a depleting supply. Energy efficiency is also a key initiative for the Company in reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Therefore, the Company continues to make various efforts to carry out energy efficiency, conduct routine recording and reporting (which is carried out by the General Affairs and Procurement Division) and conduct periodic evaluations. [GRI 305-5] [OJK F.12]

Since 2022, the Company has gradually replaced operational vehicles that previously used fuel to electric vehicles. In May 2024, the Company purchased 7 units of operational cars with a hybrid system, which combines a gasoline engine with an electric motor, replacing operational cars that still use fuel to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions.

Perseroan menghitung konsumsi energi di dalam dan di luar organisasi. Konsumsi energi di dalam organisasi mencakup konsumsi litrik kegiatan kantor, konsumsi listrik mobil operasional dan konsumsi BBM mobil operasional. Untuk konsumsi energi dari penggunaan listrik, perhitungan dilakukan dengan mengkonversi penggunaan listrik dalam kilowatt hour (kWh) menjadi giga joule (GJ). Kemudian untuk konsumsi BBM, perhitungan dilakukan dengan mengilikan konsumsi BBM dalam liter (L) dengan berat Jenis BBM (kg/liter) berdasarkan dokumen Spesifikasi Produk BBM, BBN, dan LPG yang dikeluarkan oleh Pertamina. Hasil perhitungan berupa berat BBM dalam kilogram (kg) kemudian dikalikan dengan Nett Calorific Value (NCV) (MJ/kg) sesuai dengan Faktor Emisi BBM yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral. Pada tahun 2024, total konsumsi energi di dalam organisasi adalah 5.335 GJ, turun dibandingkan tahun 2023 sebesar 346 GJ.

In addition to implementing the Presidential Instruction of the Republic of Indonesia No. 13 of 2011 concerning Energy and Water Saving, electricity saving in the Company is also in line with the Regulation of the Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) No. 13 of 2012 concerning Electricity Usage Efficiency.

The Company does not have specific policies related to the reduction of energy required for products and services because PT SMI's business is infrastructure financing to debtors, not product and service producing companies such as manufacturing companies or the like. [GRI 302-5]

In addition to measuring energy consumption within the organization, the Company also calculates energy usage outside the organization, which is limited to energy consumption from business travel and employee commuting. The estimated energy consumption data is derived from the conversion of emission values generated by these two energy consumption items. Currently, the Company has not yet used renewable energy sources. [302-1]

The Company calculates energy consumption both within and outside the organization. Internal energy consumption includes electricity usage for office activities, electricity consumption for operational vehicles, and fuel consumption for operational vehicles. For electricity consumption, the calculation is performed by converting electricity usage in kilowatt-hours (kWh) into gigajoules (GJ). For fuel consumption, the calculation involves multiplying the fuel consumption in liters (L) by the fuel's specific gravity (kg/L), based on the Fuel, Biofuel, and LPG Product Specification Document issued by Pertamina. The resulting fuel weight in kilograms (kg) is then multiplied by the Nett Calorific Value (NCV) (MJ/kg), in accordance with the fuel emission factor issued by the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources. In 2024, the total internal energy consumption was 5,335 GJ, reflecting a decrease of 346 GJ compared to 2023.
